title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Attention all Dogtown residents! This is Kurt Hansen.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: An unmarked aircraft has crashed in our district.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: The crash site is now a restricted area.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: My people will proceed to secure it. The rest of you – go home and stay there.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: I'm imposing a state of emergency in Dogtown until further notice.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: More news to come as the situation develops.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: That is, unless you wanna catch a stray bullet.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: The cyberpsycho who barged into Dogtown without registering – his bounty's now doubled.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Good news. Yesterday we completed some necessary repairs at the hospital.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Scavenger representatives will be arriving Tuesday on business.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Good news, Dogtown. A certain president has turned up in Washington, safe and sound.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Here's the score: soon, it'll be seven years since we brought forth our new home here.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Hello, Dogtown. This is Kurt Hansen.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Attention all Dogtown residents. This is Kurt Hansen.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Attention! This is Kurt Hansen.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Over and out.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: That'll be all.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: More news to come shortly.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: We've got some important guests in Dogtown, here by my personal invitation. Stay out of their way.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Attention, Dogtown! This is Bennett.
speaker: bennett

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Attention Dogtown! Lieuten-- COLONEL Bennett speaking!
speaker: bennett

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: In case you haven't heard, Dogtown has a special guest. Rosalind Myers, as she lives and breathes.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Hello, Dogtown. This is Jago.
speaker: jago

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Colonel Kurt Hansen is dead. I repeat: Kurt Hansen is dead.
speaker: bennett

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: It's a dark day here in Dogtown.
speaker: bennett

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Kurt Hansen may be dead, but BARGHEST is alive and well!
speaker: bennett

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: How the fuck d'you turn this thing off...?
speaker: bennett

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: His description: a big-ass motherfucker with a full faceplate.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Armed, dangerous, unresponsive to any attempts at contact. Fire without warning.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: The NUSA says the president managed to crash her Space Force One into our humble district.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: If that's true, well, we've got to find her. For her own safety.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Any information on Myers I will personally reward. In neurostims.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: We've increased our presence on the streets and at the border checkpoints. Nobody goes in or out without a permit.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: The Colonel went out the way he lived – gun in hand. And the motherfuckers who took him out? Oh, they'll pay. You know why?
speaker: bennett

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Two months of hard work have finally paid off. Starting today, the hospital and its staff will be operating under our protection.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: You need stitches? A new leg? Report directly to Dr. Robertson.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Our Balkan-based friends might have a little jetlag, so I want everyone in their homes by six sharp.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Blinds down, no scrolling.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Over the years our endurance was tested – by force, by coercion, by empty promises. But we endured. And hell, I'm moved to reminisce.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: These days, you could light a smoke and spit the butt over to the other side. But I tell you what – seven years ago, that channel was broader and you didn't spit butts, you spat lead.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: I received three orders during our attack on the city. The first – take the peninsula south of the storm channel. We did. The second – set up bases, hold 'em. We held.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: The third – withdraw. Fuck your positions. Well, that was the final order. You know why? Look at that storm channel. I see you sippin' beer there by day, collecting cargo by night. Shit's downright bucolic.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Let me tell you about Stan. Stan was a fine Southern boy. Dreamed of a career in dance, wound up in our assault force. Life doesn't always give you a choice.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: That night, Stan was runnin' in front of me. When he suddenly spun round like he was doin' a pirouette, I thought: fuckin' Christ Stan, not now! And then I saw the enemy snipers.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Joey – mechanic from Atlanta, two kids. Emily – engineer with a heart of gold. Carl – paramedic, no heart and a weird thirst for blood, but hell, you'd still like the guy.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: I won't give you their ranks. I'd rather remember their names. Too many names to count...
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: We did it. Everything we were ordered to do. And then the brass decided to flush us down the storm drain. YOU'RE GONE – I heard – WERE NEVER THERE. And I'd had enough of the lies.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: A moment of silence for Stan and the rest? ...No. I got a better idea. Grab your iron, whatever you got. Go out on the street and give 'em a thousand-gun salute.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: They earned it. Let 'em know up in high heaven that Dogtown's still kickin'. Let 'em know we're still here – and fuck if we're goin' anywhere else!
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Still no news of our missing Madam President.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: For those who don't know me – I've replaced Colonel Kurt Hansen. May he rest in peace.
speaker: jago

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: We're introducing some organizational changes, but trust your business interests in the district remain secure.
speaker: jago

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: I'll do my best to fill the shoes of the one man our town, Dogtown, owes everything to.
speaker: jago

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: This will be the final radio announcement. We are working on a more... contemporary means of communication.
speaker: jago

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Over?
speaker: jago

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: It's official. Starting today, I'm in charge of BARGHEST.
speaker: bennett

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: You residents of Dogtown can look forward to a bright future full of uh... bright days.
speaker: bennett

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Meanin' residents who know how to follow orders, of course.
speaker: bennett

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: That's all for now. Over and out.
speaker: bennett

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: I have to say, I'm a little... disappointed.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Reward's doubled for any intel on Rosalind Myers' whereabouts. Over and out.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Now, if I were a betting man, I'd say she was there all along. Our unflinching response to the NUSA's blatant provocation proved effective.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: I'm being framed – isn't it obvious? The NUSA's been out for my blood for years.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: What transpired in Dogtown is no trivial matter. I urge you all to consider the true motives behind this… spectacle.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Now, I'm not without flaws. But another thing I'm not is suicidal. An attempt on the life of the head of the NUSA?
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Will they stop there? No. You, good people of Night City, are next in the fucking line.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: The NUSA will take any excuse it can get to send forces into Dogtown.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Mark my words… another war's on its way.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: This is Kurt Hansen. You are now in Dogtown.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Rule two – no corps! You're just not welcome!
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Rule one – no NCPD! Badges'll get a bullet to the brain!
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Rule three – my people keep the peace in the district and ensure its security. They are the law.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Follow the rules or face the consequences.
speaker: kurt_krauser

text: No invite? Keep out. If you know what's good for you.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Attention all Dogtown residents! This is Kurt Hansen.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: They will be welcomed at the Black Sapphire. The event is invitation-only.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: What else can I say...
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Rosalind, if you're ever really in Dogtown, we're ready to welcome you with open arms.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Attention all residents! This is Kurt Hansen.
speaker: kurt_krauser

title: ep1_radio_03_kurt
text: Enemy collaborators have infiltrated Dogtown.
speaker: kurt_krauser

speaker: kurt_krauser

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Where'd it happen?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Her booth. Told you, she was with a client.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Gonna just stand there or tell me a number?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Eleven.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: I'm afraid of becoming someone else, forgetting who I am.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: You're already becoming someone else, every second of every day.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Still, I feel... a connection between who I was and who I'm turning into.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: What you really fear is becoming someone you don't recognize in the least.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: You don't see death as destruction, the end, but as a change.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: I'm not grieving.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Grief doesn't begin to describe it.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: What I've been through – tough to move on from that.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Wasn't enough I died once. Have to go and do it again.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Death's' absurdity, the futile struggle before – these terrify you.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: What's past is past. I'm over it.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: You're in denial – don't you see?
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Would it change things even by a hair if I wasn't?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Need to get inside that booth somehow.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Yeah? And do what?
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: None of your biz. Can you open it or not?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Sure, just don't bother me again. Ever. Talk to Tom.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: I'm looking for a girl.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: How do you know I'm dying?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Safeword] Afterlife.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Safeword] Samurai.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: I'm looking for someone.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: There's something in those mirrors.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Safeword] Afterlife.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Safeword] Samurai.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: How do I get in?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Is it occupied now?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: This booth occupied now?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Nah, I think it's been "out of order" since, uh…
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Fear isn't a weakness. It's there to protect you.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Or is it just the fear of becoming someone else, different?
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: But I know you'll find her. You always get your way.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: You just gonna talk in circles, that it?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: I can't help you if you don't want to be helped.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: From what? Losing myself? Becoming a stranger in my own body?
text_male: From what? Losin' myself? Becomin' a stranger in my own body?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: What's next? Meditation?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Something like that. Try me.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: That thought alone could save your life.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Need to talk to you.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Look, I don't know anyone named Evelyn.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: What'm I afraid of?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: This is what "fulfilling my deepest desires" looks like?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Tell me where Evelyn is.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Just gonna talk in circles, in riddles?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Safeword] Afterlife.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Safeword] Samurai.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: I died and now I'm dying again. Happy?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: We're not having this conversation.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: I'm alone, got nobody left.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Safeword] Afterlife.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Safeword] Samurai.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: You can't come to terms with something like that.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: So I just give up?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Still wanna be the best.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Pure fantasy, that.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Safeword] Afterlife.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Safeword] Samurai.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Lie down] Not gonna die completely.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Lie down] The void freaks me out.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Safeword] Afterlife.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Safeword] Samurai.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: I'm scared of the unknown, of dying again.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Can't imagine what it's like to become someone else.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Safeword] Afterlife.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Safeword] Samurai.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: There anything you DO know?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: You're talkin' to the wrong doll, honey. You really wanna know, talk to Tom. Even better – Woodman.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: He work here?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Pick o' the litter at Clouds. He's over in the VIP area. Booth two.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Just said I should, didn't you?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: They'll kill you if you try.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: And why's that? What's this Woodman do?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: It's OK. Calm down.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Calm down. Just wanna ask you a question.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: I'll calm down when you leave me alone. Get out! Now!
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: How fast I leave depends on how fast you answer.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: So what now?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Now you find out what it is you need to do.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Which is? You're gonna tell me?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: You've never backed down from anything in your life, even when you maybe should've.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: You go through Night City knowing a stray bullet could end you while hailing a cab.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: But that's never stopped you from taking action, going where you needed to go. And it won't stop you now.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: But how do I keep up with everything that's changing...?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: You have been keeping up. You've made an impact. Not a single thing in this world isn't in the process of becoming something else. Likewise you.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Never look back. If you gotta kill, kill. If you gotta burn it all to the ground, then let it burn.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: So what now?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Safeword] Afterlife.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Safeword] Samurai.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Thanks, um... for all this.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Jeez. Don't even feel like getting up…
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Few do. But everything has its end.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: What happened? I do something wrong?
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Death was something that happened to other people – hell, that I DEALT to others. Now my number'll be up.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Thank you.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: So what if I do? Why do you care?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: I'm here to fulfill your deepest, most hidden desire.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Soon I'll be gone too. 'Cept, won't have anyone by my side.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Fear of death is what drives us all to do what we do.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Sit] This'll be interesting...
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Welp, looks like this'll be interesting…
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Touch] Not sure I can manage…
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Start talking.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Notice anything unusual?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: You're good looking. It'd be a shame to lose that.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Anyone 'sides me come around lookin' for her?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Hey... Talk to me?
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: If you're done here, you should go.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: An enny for your thoughts.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Silent… why?
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: This some kind of seizure?
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Ghost now, or I'll call security.
speaker: Doll

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: [Open]
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: What do you know about Evelyn?
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: If it's money you want, name your price.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Please, help me.
speaker: V

title: q105_03a_dollhouse_doll_02
text: Wouldn't want to lose your good looks now, would you?
speaker: V

title: cz_terra_cognita_chat_01

text: Terra Cognita... It was supposed to be some kind of exhibition, right?

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Stubborn ass... Remember Daniels? S'posed to help you with this gig.
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Can't say I remember.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Honestly, all badges look the same to me.
text_male: Honestly? All badges look the same to me.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Daniels, choom who drove up when we was chatting by my garage. He took one of the cars… yeah, whatever.
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Guy's hard to forget.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Why gimme a gig with the NCPD?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Muamar, what's the matter?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Quit bein' a chickenshit cunt, Muamar – we got this!
speaker: daniels

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Yeah. Pig who picked up a ride when I dropped by your chop shop.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: What was that all about?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: You two fighting?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Anyway, listen up. You're goin' to Corpo Plaza, Arasaka docks. Gonna swipe us a truck haulin' med equipment.
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: My garage. But yeah, that's him.
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Your backup? Daniels and his buddies from the NCPD. They'll be incognito, dressed as workers. You head on over – Daniels'll be in touch.
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Mm... If we pull it off, the kids in SanDomo won't have to go through what I did. Anyway… I need a smoke. Go on, give a choom some space.
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: So it's me an' the NCPD kleppin' corpo property – together. You trust 'em?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Muamar, somethin' wrong? Actin' weirdly, uh, composed.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Ah, El Capitan the joker needs a fuckin' break. He'll be back... You know, I grew up here. Me 'n' Daniels. Santo fuckin' Domingo.
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: You know what we were most scared of as kids?
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Ah, it's just a little after-hours side gig for Daniels and his badge bros. But do I trust him? Shit, we grew up together. Right here in Santo Domingo.
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Gangs, right?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Guessin' it wasn't monsters, huh?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Gangs? A stray bullet?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Guessin' it wasn't monsters under the bed.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Biggest fear was a glass of water. Y'see, the filters sometimes gonked out. Any sip could be your last.
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Talkin' cancer, arthritis, kids with the joints of seventy-year-olds. All in a fucking glass of water. In these homes, every damn day, years on end.
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Yeah, those too, but no – talkin' a different, everyday fear.
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Mm... Unfortunately, no.
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: One of his men dropped out. After weeks of prep. Me, I'm thinkin' that's a problem that could bite us in the ass. Daniels disagrees. Anyways, you 'member the guy, right?
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Shit. This is 'Saka's doin', gotta be.
speaker: johnny

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: So this medical gear'll help?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Y'know, could find the person responsible.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: How bad was it?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Arasaka factories been pumpin' poison into the groundwater here since 2061. 'Course, we didn't know how bad it was for a good, long while.
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: As I fuckin' thought.
speaker: johnny

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Shit, how bad was it?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Was? Still is. Everyone here's lost someone, every kid's battling some disease or disorder. Guessin' me an' Daniels won't live to a ripe old age, either.
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Could breach 'Saka's dataforts, find the person responsible. Y'know, whoever covered up the leaks.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: So this med equipment, it's gonna help the sick, right?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Already did. Name's Maria Sparks. Looked her right in the eye, thought about what to do for a long while. Y'know their employees drank the water? They didn't tell them either.
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Arasaka wanted the data buried. No surprise. So what'd you do?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Recruited her. Thanks to her, we know about the transport. I mean, I'm a fixer, ain't I? Make contacts, get things done.
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Should ease some of their suffering, yeah. The most important thing is, peeps'll see someone still gives half a shit. Maybe they'll feel somethin' 'sides fear for a change.
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Stealin' for the greater good. The system, man, it's all kinds of fucked up, V. Anyway, get going. And don't let us down.
speaker: fixer

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: I won't.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: You, V – don't you fuck up down at the docks!
speaker: daniels

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Riiight, where've I heard that one before? They all say they want "space" but what they really wanna hear is "Muamar, is everything OK?"
speaker: johnny

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Shit, not a single "your majesty." Keeps goin' like this, El Clowno might even get a haircut.
speaker: johnny

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: I gotta be your fuckin' empathy coach now too? Choom clearly wants to talk about it, just can't say so.
speaker: johnny

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: That all?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: That's a big op, any tips?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Great. That all?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Kleppin' a truck off Arasaka's docks is a big ask. Any tips?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_courier_outro_muammar_dam
text: Hm, better go at night. Security'll be lower. Daniels'll give you more detes.
speaker: fixer

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay

text: Mh, real pearl of wisdom…

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: Fuck, finally!
speaker: bottom_enemy_005

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: Ehh… y'ever miss it?
speaker: bottom_enemy_001

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: What, what?
speaker: bottom_enemy_006

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: Here we go!
speaker: bottom_enemy_005

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: What, where?
speaker: bottom_enemy_006

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: Combat! Firefight! Fightin' fire! Boom, adrenaline!
speaker: bottom_enemy_005

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: Don't get enough already?
speaker: bottom_enemy_006

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: Of what? Sittin' on my ass? Wavin' chooms through at the border?
speaker: bottom_enemy_005

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: Y'ain't bored outta your skull out there?
speaker: bottom_enemy_005

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: Choom. I got a wife, three kids.
speaker: bottom_enemy_006

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: Miss what?
speaker: bottom_enemy_002

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: Bein' in a real army. Normal rank 'n' file, chain of command…
speaker: bottom_enemy_001

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: Chain of command can eat my ass. But the eddies did add up…
speaker: bottom_enemy_002

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: So, if you could go back...?
speaker: bottom_enemy_001

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: No way, wouldn't.
speaker: bottom_enemy_002

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: Why not?
speaker: bottom_enemy_001

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: Uh, because you can't. Hate talkin' in hypotheticals anyway.
speaker: bottom_enemy_002

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: And how's it?

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: Whatta you been doin' the past ten?

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: What's it fuckin' look like?

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: Yeah, yeah. Battery's fine. Somethin' else borked.

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: What?

title: q301_05b_crashsite_gameplay
text: If I knew we wouldn't be here.

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Gaze into the abyss, you'll find the abyss starin' right back atcha.
speaker: Johnny

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: And I don't like the look it's givin' me – the kind that says there ain't no comin' back.
speaker: Johnny

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Any more pearls of wisdom in that noggin?
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: No choice in the matter. No going back.
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Why's it always doom and gloom with you? How 'bout – "What doesn't kill you makes you stronger"?
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Don't got a choice, not really.
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Always got a choice, V. Like the choice to delta the fuck outta here, for one.
speaker: Johnny

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Try this on for size – "Go up against monsters, best make sure you don't turn into one too."
speaker: Johnny

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Lookin' at a wall with a huge hole in it. Truck rammed clean through.
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Stay sharp.
speaker: reed_holo

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: And So Mi's status?
speaker: reed_holo

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Song's not here. Truck's empty.
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Got eyes on a MaxTac officer. Or his remains, well-done.
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Song's doing, it's gotta be.
speaker: reed_holo

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Standin' in front of a gate So Mi passed through. It's jammed shut.
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: There's gotta be another way. Look around.
speaker: reed_holo

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: You have eyes on her? Is she OK?
speaker: reed_holo

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: No visual yet. Need to scope the place out.
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Crash like this, be a miracle if she wasn't mangled…
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Shit... Help her, V. Quick.
speaker: reed_holo

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: She lost control completely? Thoughts?
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Dunno, do not know.
speaker: reed_holo

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Follow 'er, stay on her. I'll make my way towards you.
speaker: reed_holo

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Sure you wanna do this?
speaker: Johnny

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: S'posed to be about me, that?
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Bout Songbird, ya ding-dong. I gotta explain every little fuckin' thing?
speaker: Johnny

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Chick sold her soul to the Blackwall demons, now she's down there waitin' for you. Question is – is she still herself?
speaker: Johnny

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Guess we're about to find out.
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Come too far, Johnny. Remember what's at stake. We don't get to Song, we don't get the help Reed promised us.
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Oh, I remember. Question is if whatever's down there is still the Songbird we know and love.
speaker: Johnny

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Find out soon enough.
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Hold on, I see the truck. Does not look good.
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: See the truck, Reed. Does not look pretty.
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Overloaded, short-circ'd just before I got here.
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Gate's jammed. Console's freshly breached. Looks like more So Mi…
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Hmm, tried to activate the winch, but no dice. That mean... she jumped?
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Seein' somethin'. A… a digital... residue? Spooky aura, a… a spectral footprint…?
text_male: Seein' somethin'. A digital... residue? Spooky aura, spectral footprint…?
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Seein' more hacked devices. She's lookin' for access. Question is, to what?
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Circuitry down here's toast. All of it.
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: She's scorchin' tech as she passes. Got a sinkin' feelin' she's no longer in complete control of her... self.
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: It's her. She can't've gone far.
speaker: reed_holo

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: From the crash?
speaker: reed_holo

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Sabotage, more like. Dead certain So Mi hacked these systems.
speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: So Mi, where are you... Keep going, V. Don't let her get too far.
speaker: reed_holo

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: No clue... Whatever it is, I'm liking it less and less.
speaker: reed_holo

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Might not be Song anymore, true. Which means she needs our help. Hurry, V, find her.
speaker: reed_holo

text: Circuitry's dead. Blackwall?

speaker: V

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Winch...?
speaker: V

text: Remember, V. As long as So Mi's alive, we stand a chance of regaining control.

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: She's in bad shape, V.
speaker: reed_holo

text: She's overloadin' tech…

text: She's actively linked to the Blackwall. She could lose the control she still has at any second.
speaker: reed_holo

title: q305_06_chase_scenes
text: Stay safe.
speaker: reed_holo

speaker: V

text: Same goes for you.

text: Will do.

text: I'll be fine. I'll rejoin you soon as I'm back on my feet. You keep moving.

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: Bet you've all heard the big news by now – Space Force One crash lands smack in the middle of Dogtown... And with NUSA President Rosalind Myers still on board.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: Lend me your ears, Night City. This is Maximum Mike and I'm telling you, this story's a big one.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: I'm guessin' not many of you have ever stepped foot into Dogtown. And no wonder. This hostile part of Pacifica belongs to one Kurt Hansen – an ex-Militech soldier turned self-appointed dictator. And it's the dictator who's got beef with the NUS president.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: Washington claims, of course, that Myers wasn't among the passengers of the ill-fated flight. Mhm… yeah, right.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: Folks, this wasn't some freak accident, a stroke of supremely bad luck, no. Myers was most definitely on board, and it was Kurt Hansen who gave the order to blast her outta the sky.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: Now, you might thinkin' to yourself – OK, I buy that, but why make such a desperate move? And why now?
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: So let me give it to you straight. There's a lot of politicos in the upper echelons of the NUS government, and even more "old friends" from Myers' Militech days, and they dream of another Unification War. Of putting an end to Arasaka's expansion on American soil.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: Once... and for all.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: I mean, can you fathom any better justification for a call to arms? The assassination of the NUS president? And in the infamous Free City of Night City, no less? I call that "preem".
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: As for Militech coverin' their asses, that's why they kept Hansen on their shadow payroll. When the sabers start rattlin' and the blame starts flyin', it's gonna land squarely on him, a deserter of their own corp.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: Think on it, sleep on it... but don't you dare wait on it. Another war may be just around the corner. You wanna stay ahead of it.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: In return, he gets carte blanche – absolute rule over Dogtown. Provided the loyal hound still knows when to heel.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: Some chombattas of mine from Europe recently educated me on a crime syndicate based in Paris known widely as "Le Collectif," or "The Collective."
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: But hold that thought. Who's really behind this? The answer will surprise you. Guess all you want, you're not even gonna be close.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: Surprised? Yeah, I didn't think so. A warlord of Hansen's caliber isn't likely to be short on enemies. Now, if you're a regular listener, the first thought that popped into your head was the obvious – "probably Militech." Just them tyin' up a loose end…
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: Kurt Hansen, self-appointed tyrant of Dogtown, has been killed.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: It's not their official name per se, but so little is known about this… "association" that the line between fact and fiction... is difficult to draw. That said, The Collective makes one thing is certain – that the European democratic system is just pretty window dressing. Nothing more.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: The real strings of The Collective are being pulled by French monarchists – the Legitimists, Orleanists... Bonapartists. All of them with links to local terrorist cells.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: The attacks on the Bastille, the Arc de Triomphe, the Waterloo bombing – these were statements made by real power and its shrewd consolidation.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: And the legit French government? Don't they have any clout? Whatever non-monarchists do remain there, they know when to look the other away, and where to look when they do.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: So you're thinking: "OK, Max Mike... where ya goin' with all this? What's it got to do with Kurt Hansen?" Heh. Well, here's my theory...
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: Skylight… That name ring a bell? That's right – the notorious netrunner. Rumor is, well, first off, it's not just single person, but a duo. And second, that whoever they are, they got on The Collective's bad side.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: Now for the twist. These 'runners – Skylight – they started working for Hansen instead, and my sources say had ambitious plans to expand his operation into Europe, right under The Collective's nose.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: No, people, this regicide was no fluke. Hansen believed his walls made him invincible. And he was wrong. And for his hubris, he paid the ultimate price.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: Think about it. What better way to send a message to the world than by taking down one of Night City's most powerful people in his own backyard…
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: So people, let me know what you all think. I'd love to hear your thoughts.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: ep1_radio_04_mike
text: Simple. This was coup, but not only his own. It's a coup d'état long planned by people in Myers' own cabinet.
speaker: maximum_mike

text: Let's say I let you walk. What happens then? Lay it out.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: I-I dunno! I'll… I'll look for help, hit up some big-name rippers. Not callin' it quits yet, ending up like some fuckin' cripple.
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: If it's cyberpsychosis, then maybe there's still hope for him. Thinkin' Regina.
text_male: If it is cyberpsychosis, then maybe there's still hope for him. Thinkin' Regina.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Knew plenty who joined the army to make a quick buck – hell, was one of 'em myself. But eight years to sprout a conscience? Nah, fuck that.
speaker: johnny

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Put 'im down? That your solution?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Karma. Had it comin' to 'im. 'Course, 'less you're gonna take pity on every asshole who starts feelin' blue.
speaker: johnny

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: I'm Rinder, or 'least what's left of 'im. That asshole Hansen's rottin' in the ground… so who sent you?
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: I'm Rinder all right, or 'least what's left of 'im. Guessin' you're here on contract. Hansen send you?
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Ain't Rinder. Just a mountain of a scav.
speaker: johnny

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Easy to feel sorry when there's a gun to your head. Don't let the murderin' piece o' shit tug at your heartstrings, V.
speaker: johnny

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Dogtown chewed 'im up, shat 'im out. Place must be packed with hapless turds like him. Be simpler if it was all Hansen's fault, but that ain't how it works.
speaker: johnny

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: [Shoot] I'm here to kill you.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Blackouts… Ain't always… present. I'm sick, OK?! Sounds like you know more'n me.
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: You killed Jason and seven others.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Memory blackouts? How convenient.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Did the scavs do this to you?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: You let scavs carve you up like a Thanksgiving turkey… Why?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Now you're gonna tell me that hulking slab of scav that came at me was your ripper?
text_male: Now you're gonna tell me that hulking slab of a scav that came at me was your ripper?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: You killed that kid, Jason, 'long with seven others. Why, what for?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Everyone's makin' you out like some crazed killer – the butcher of Dogtown. And here you are hatchin' weak-ass excuses?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Why did you leave BARGHEST?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: I'm sick, all right? Wanted to pawn my chrome, collect enough scratch to get treated. Jason was my go-between with the local scavs.
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Cept he tried to give me the Dogtown shakedown, first! Startin' wavin' his big-dick iron. Fuckin' savage. And then… I-I can't remember…
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: And here you are, meanin' he did his part.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Tell me – what don't I know 'bout Dogtown?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: You and Hansen – what happened? Left you on the rocks?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: You got eyes? Tossed me to rot in the gutter – my chooms, too. Eight years I gave that asshole…
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Wasn't the scavs tried to fuck me over – was that shit-weasel, Jason! Dogtown's teemin' with filth like him. Makes BARGHEST look good in comparison!
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: See how they live in those cargo containers? Bunch of fuckin' savages. Can't have folks leavin', either – nuh-huh. Want you to rot right there beside 'em!
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: If anyone's a savage, it's you.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: What about all those years you spent doing Hansen's dirty work?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Sick with what?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Rippers in Dogtown – none of 'em could help? Say what's ailin' ya?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: If they did, you think I'd have myself gutted like a fish? Rippin' out third-gen combat-'ware and chippin' myself with crooked chrome for what – shits and gigs?
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: I was there. Savage, what you did. Makes you the savage.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Been doin' Hansen's dirty work for years, tyin' off loose ends. That all a blackout, too?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Fuck you want me to say? That I admit to all the sins I've committed – remembered, forgotten and all in between? Fine!
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: I regret it, OK? I regret all the years with Hansen… joined up when I was just a kid. Kept my head down, followed orders. Whatever I did, I'm sorry! As if you know shit about Dogtown, anyhow…
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Tell them Leon Rinder's dead and-- and you wouldn't even be lyin'! Do that and the gear I stashed – it's yours!
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Or… no, fuck it! I won't beg. Shoot if you want!
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: 'Cause I told 'em to, what'd ya think? Sold 'em my chrome. Might be twisted fucks, but they keep their word.
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: That bumblin' buffoon? Heh! Just proof they can't guard for shit.
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Enlighten me. What's Dogtown really like?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Listen to me, just listen! I'm expired goods, a walkin' corpse! Can't decomish me more than this!
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Gonna need your dog tag, hand it over.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: H-here… Take it.
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: So long.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Flicking you some coordinates… just go there, you'll see. And uh… thanks.
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Go already.
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: This where Rinder came to do biz? An abandoned motel crawling with organ kleppers?
speaker: johnny

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Rinder's leadspitter. He got here all right.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Biomonitors. Scavs're reprogrammin' them to jam signals in similar models. Just like they did with Sandra Dorsett's biomon.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: One with the BARGHEST vest's got "Rinder" written on it... and prices on its arms and legs. Scavs sold him for parts?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Scavenger – freshly operated. Out cold, but still breathin'.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Wonder if we'll find him on the first floor, or on all of 'em, chopped into little bits.
speaker: johnny

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: One of them's Rinder's. See?
speaker: johnny

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Well, well…
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: No clue. Only thing we do know's the fucker cost an arm and a leg.
speaker: johnny

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Hilarious. Let's just find him, his dog tag – whatever's left of 'im.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Not a second do these sickos waste. Chrome from their victims' bodies hasn't even cooled 'fore they're chippin' it.
speaker: johnny

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Bloodstains, almost fresh. Looks like they carved someone up here recently.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Guts on the walls, blood on the floor, optical on the table. Interior decoration – Scav edition.
speaker: johnny

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Not our guy.
speaker: johnny

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Killing you would be doing you a favor.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Think I've heard enough.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Came to zero you. Now I think that'd just be doin' you a favor.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Fuck you!
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Save it. Can yell all you want in this sad, empty room once I'm gone.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Fuck you!
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: Right. Got two options. One – you hand over your dog tag and I delta. Wanna know the second?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: No.
speaker: rinder

title: sts_ep1_03_wagner_standoff
text: If the Scavs don't carve up what's left of ya, Night City'll finish the job.
speaker: V

text: Psh, I ain’t nobody’s doll!
speaker: actor_02

title: ep1_combat_zone_conversation_019
text: Christ, choom, chill. Not a doll, just a walking ad. Hm?
speaker: actor_01

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: Mike. What's up with you?
speaker: V

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: V. Got a lotta nerve, showin’ yer faceplate here.
speaker: Michael

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: Someone told Eric the testimony was mine. The Tinos came, trashed my arcade. I got nothin’, man, nothin...
speaker: Michael

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: How are ya?
speaker: V

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: V, good to see ya!
speaker: Michael

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: Had the hearin’ day before yesterday. Eric’s a free man.
speaker: Michael

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: How’d Eric’s day in court go?
speaker: V

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: Get a chance to meet up with your son?
speaker: V

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: No... Called him, though. Pretty pissed he landed behind bars in the first place. In no mood for a longer talk.
speaker: Michael

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: Manage to live off these machines?
speaker: V

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: You makin' a decent livin’ off these games?
speaker: V

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: I'm sorry, really.
speaker: V

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: Shit, sorry Mike. Zembinsky said you’d be safe.
speaker: V

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: Safe? Maybe technically. Eric's gangoons said they wouldn’t touch me... Me bein’ his pops ‘n’ all.
speaker: Michael

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: Maybe you shouldn’ta ratted on your own kid.
speaker: V

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: Got what was comin’ to ya.
speaker: V

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: Not much, not bad. Ends’re meetin’ up somehow. Can't rightly complain.
speaker: Michael

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: Thanks again for all your help.
speaker: Michael

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: Honestly? I’m scrapin’ by. Rent, somethin’ to eat, that's it. Gotta repair the damn things myself.
speaker: Michael

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: But I ain't a whiner. Got some eddies set aside, might put up one o' them pachinkos. Big cred pull.
speaker: Michael

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: Preem. Fingers crossed.
speaker: V

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: Well... maybe he’ll stop by someday. Could have a long, honest talk then.
speaker: V

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: Yeah, dunno... maybe.
speaker: Michael

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: Mike? What happened?
speaker: V

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: ‘Stead they wailed on my machines. What’m I s'posed to do now?
speaker: Michael

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: Shoulda just done what I asked. This here – this's all your fault.
speaker: Michael

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: Yeah, you. Wanna start throwin' blame, start with yourself.
speaker: V

title: michael_maldonado_default
text: What's with you?
speaker: V

text: Here, now, I call upon Night Corp's governors and executives to accept both financial and legal responsibility for this act of barbarism!

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Ah, at last.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Not here for tea.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: 'S cool, not here for tea. What's so urgent?
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: No ordinary job, to be sure. Dogtown's future hangs in the balance.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Don't worry, got this.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Once you've shown him reason, call me. And remember, my district's future is riding on this.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Don't worry, won't disappoint.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: That is the hope. Good luck.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: I lacked the time to brew tea. My apologies.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Open
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: [Take shard] Got someone in mind, don'tcha?
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Lemme guess – got a successor all lined up, don'tcha.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: The logical choice, this gentleman soldier. Alas, he has competition – a man named Jago.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: What's Bennett's story?
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Sorry, Hands. Rather keep my mitts outta politics for a little.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: And people complain when their ambivalence yields no progress... It seems you wasted a trip.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Wait.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: I'll double your usual rate. And provide support. Are you certain you want to leave?
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Deal. Got a gift for persuasion, Hands.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Jago not up to snuff? Why?
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Yes, Hands. Open the goddamn door.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: OK, I'll handle that.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Sharp, Hands. Got a keen eye for biz. I'm in. I'll handle it.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: No, you won't. But Aguilar will.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: So, need me to pose as this Aguilar.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Your loss, not Dogtown's. I'll find someone else.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Lemme summarize. Need me to assume Aguilar's identity…
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Have a chat with Jago, talk him out of any silly ideas he might have... Child's play.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: All clear.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Need some more info on Aguilar.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Yes. Door, please.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Ex-Marine, took part in Operation Midnight Storm. He never questioned orders, didn't serve for glory or medals. Loyal from start to finish.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: OK, all's crystal.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: I've prepared a shard with helpful intelligence. Also a weapon – the same Aguilar uses. Help yourself to both.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: [Take imprint] OK.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: You'll make a strong impression on Jago, too. A trusted source tells me he's to meet soon with a delegation of the Dogtown Voodoos. I'll forward the coordinates.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Kurt Hansen – a man of many hats. A criminal, dog of war…
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Merc assassin, huh? Color me curious. Anything else I oughta know?
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Changes comin' for BARGHEST, huh?
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Guessin' changes afoot for BARGHEST, huh? What with Hansen flatlined?
text_male: Guessin' changes afoot for BARGHEST, huh? What with Hansen flatlined.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Hmm. Don't envy whoever's fillin' his boots. Man, it'll be a looong road to restorin' order, even in their own ranks.
speaker: npc1

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Dogtown – what's the mood these days?
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: So, Dogtown – what's the mood like now?
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: On edge. Who knows what'll happen next. Colonel had the 'hood's balls in his iron jaws, but, man, it all  worked somehow. Now…?
speaker: npc1

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: I'm lucky to have her behavioral imprint on hand. You're lucky to have experience with the tech already.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Bennett – tell me more.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Anything else I should know about Aguilar?
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: [Activate imprint]
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: [Take gun] Interesting piece.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Interesting piece of iron.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: So's yours. Don't fuck me over.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Dogtown's future and yours. Don't fuck me over, Hands.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Hah, rehearsing, are you? Close, just a bit lacking. Good luck.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Dogtown without the colonel... Can't hardly imagine it…
speaker: npc1

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Oh please, brother, he a common thug. Not even that – not no more. Worm food's worm food.
speaker: npc2

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Tone it down, choomba! Wanna wind up like him?
speaker: npc1

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Face-to-face again? What's changed?
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Everything. And that's what we'll discuss.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Another meet in the flesh. Startin' to feel special.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: To mine eye – an entrepreneur. And business suffocates in a vacuum.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Vultures circle the colonel's corpse already. The enterprise he built must choose a new leader.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: We will make certain they choose correctly.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Lieutenant Colonel Bennett. One of Hansen's most loyal. Commands respect, is capable of rallying a strong base.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: What's this "we"? And whence "our" interest?
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Uh-huh... And why's it "we" care?
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: I take the long view of Dogtown's well-being. You care for short-term profit. Should Dogtown drown in blood, neither is achievable.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Do you feel the difference?
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Seriously, Hands? You make me your guinea pig for untested tech? Thought you valued your well-being more than that.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Seriously, Hands? Makin' me your guinea pig for untested tech? Thought you valued your well-being more than that.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Hm. Better than expected, V... or rather, Aguilar.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: He's an accountant, no soldier. Kept Hansen's books for him. V, you don't win hearts by counting numbers.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Uh, ya lost me.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Enter Aguilar – a merc assassin from Havana. A living legend...
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Hansen remained on top because he had the contacts to stay afloat. Most important among them was a Cuban cartel.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Custom-made. A unique and highly persuasive tool.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Every time someone in Havana lights a cigar, Aguilar extinguishes a life somewhere around the globe.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Rumors, perhaps. But rumors often make for crowning arguments in negotiation.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Hm, turnin' me into your guinea pig now?
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: My time's precious, Hands. If this don't work, you'll need to find ten new digits or aim for a rebrand.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: My time's precious, Hands. If this don't work, you'll need to find ten new digits or aim for a rebrand.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Whoah.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: He's starting from a lower rung but has high aspirations. He's already begun seeking outside support – from the Voodoo Boys.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: What's wrong with Jago?
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Count me in.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Pass. Plain sick of politics.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Time to kick the tires, V. Suit up and take the imprint for a whirl.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Mhm...
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Works dandy.
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Real name – unknown. Body count – unknown. Conservative estimates put it in the dozens... per continent.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Now peeps gotta take care of themselves. 'Parently a problem, that. For some.
speaker: npc2

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Tellin' you, man, they gonna implode. And good fuckin' riddance, I say.
speaker: npc2

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: You will meet with Jago. You will convince him to back down.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: I care not at all for how you handle the gangoons. As you will. I have only one request – Jago withdraws his candidacy.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: The shard, please, insert it.
speaker: Hands

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: OK, fine. Convincing enough…
speaker: V

title: mq304_02_hands_briefing
text: Y'know… mm, sure. Changed my mind. I'll take on the gig.

text: All just a bunch of tarot cards.

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: Well, if they did, it was lost on me.
speaker: V

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: The tarot tells the story of a fool's journey. Show me what you found, I'll tell you what's left.
speaker: misty

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: Pretty sure my brain's now beyond repair.
text_male: I'm pretty sure my brain's now beyond repair.
speaker: V

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: Here.
speaker: V

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: Hm... You're still missing two arcana – Judgement and The Devil.
speaker: misty

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: Thanks.
speaker: V

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: Thanks. Didn't get much out of that, but thanks.
text_male: Thanks. Didn't get much of that, but thanks.

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: What's this Judgement about?
speaker: V

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: Rather not run into the Devil. Got a feelin' he's bad vibes.
speaker: V

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: What's up with the wandering fool?
speaker: V

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: What's Judgement represent?
speaker: V

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: The Devil doesn't sound good.
speaker: V

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: My guess is that they relate to a turning point in your life – one that's soon to arrive.
speaker: misty

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: Tell me more about this fool's journey.
speaker: V

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: The fool is you and Silverhand.
speaker: misty

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: You've traveled a long road together, discovered your potential.
speaker: misty

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: Where're we headed?
text_male: And where're we headed?
speaker: V

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: Your destination is the World, the final arcanum. Both of you waged a war on the world, so there are two possibilities – declare victory or make peace.
speaker: misty

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: Could lose the war, too.
speaker: V

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: Yes – unfortunately, that's true.
speaker: misty

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: One possible future. Of redemption, transition, awakening.
speaker: misty

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: The angel with the trumpet symbolizes the end of an era – and a call to rebirth, to a new beginning.
speaker: misty

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: That's the card of primal, dormant desires, but also the will to survive.
speaker: misty

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: Hm. Doesn't sound so bad, actually.
speaker: V

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: It also represents a false world – the trap these desires lay for you.
speaker: misty

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: You'll understand when the time comes. I can't explain everything.
speaker: misty

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: All the tarot can tell me is that you will reach the World by one of four paths.
speaker: misty

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: Meaning?
speaker: V

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: The final leg of the journey goes through the Sun, the Star, Temperance or the Devil.
speaker: misty

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: Could just die, not even get that far.
speaker: V

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: Oh, c'mon, you won't let that happen.
speaker: misty

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: Take this. It's all I can do to help.
speaker: misty

title: mq033_2_all_grafitti
text: Good luck, V. On whatever road you choose.
speaker: misty

title: cz_container_zone_chat_003
text: They’re all missing. Most are probably long dead. But as long as their photo is up here, there’s still hope.

text: So many of them, though... Wonder which one was the first.
speaker: civilian_02

text: There was this one boy from BARGHEST. When he’d disappeared, Hansen's people said the boy has deserted.
speaker: civilian_01

title: cz_container_zone_chat_003
text: His mother didn't believe them, though. She plastered his photos all over Dogtown, but someone kept taking them down.
speaker: civilian_01

title: cz_container_zone_chat_003
text: In the end, only one photo remained. Here, on this tree. Could still be here after all these years.
speaker: civilian_01

title: cz_container_zone_chat_003

title: cz_container_zone_chat_003

speaker: V

text: I have valuable data. If you help me, you get it. Everybody wins.

text: How you know he's dead?

text: SovOil ain't here – I am. Now, Bana. Spill the detes.

speaker: target

title: sts_ep1_08_target_meeting
text: She's lying. V, new orders. Kill her like the bitch dog she is and take the biomonitor. Over and out.

text: Ana...? Ana!
speaker: V

text: Don't think they buy it.

speaker: V

text: Make it quick.

title: sts_ep1_08_target_meeting
text: I'm listenin'. Go.

text: I have Bana's biomonitor. You are reasonable, so I give it to you. There's also a stash in Dogtown with my gear. I give you the coordinates, OK?

text: There a catch?

text: No catch. You let me go, that is all. What do you care about some Bana?

text: W-what do we talk for? I have valuable data for you and your people. Let's be professional, yes?
speaker: target

title: sts_ep1_08_target_meeting
text: Look, they're not "my people." Bana's besties hired me to find him or his biomon, that's it.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_08_target_meeting
text: No-no-no-no, wait. You are a merc, yes? I was doing my job, just like you. You understand?

title: sts_ep1_08_target_meeting
text: Unfortunately, I do care.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_08_target_meeting
text: Deal. Flip me the coords.

title: sts_ep1_08_target_meeting
text: Sending...
speaker: target

title: sts_ep1_08_target_meeting
text: And you – better delta.
speaker: V

text: Yes, yes. Spasibo.
speaker: target

title: sts_ep1_08_target_meeting
text: Nah, think I'll just finish my "job."
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_08_target_meeting
text: Just take the biomonitor! Please, don't shoot! You'll never see me again…
speaker: target

title: sts_ep1_08_target_meeting
text: I have a proposition. Please, hear me out.
speaker: target

title: sts_ep1_08_target_meeting
text: Fine. Deal.

text: SovOil does not simply... give up the hunt.
speaker: target

title: sts_ep1_08_target_meeting
text: Leave me be. Please.
speaker: target

text: Hmph – thing is, I do care. And you're outta luck.

text: Look, took care of the scavs chasin' ya. Only a couple hours 'fore they're on your ass again. First thing I'd do is hit the stadium, find a ripper.
