title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Hey. What's goin' on?
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: You got something?
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Right. Explain this "creative license."
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Your Mizutani's got an electronics problem.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Y'know, issues with the electronics in the Mizutani Shion MZ2 are usually the on-board comp's fault. Could help ya out, take a look.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, V, boundaries, please. There's certain things I don't do halfway – I'm talkin' my clothes, my cut, my cars. I'll handle 'er myself.
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Wanted to ask about those "speed bumps" I ran into.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Ah, 6th Street? Just a little biz disagreement. Better get used to bumps like that if you wanna work with me.
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Got a need for speed, huh? Yeah, me too! OK, first thing – not a scratch on the car you brought. Terrible V, awful. Bleh, perfection gives me the creeps.
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Got a need for speed, huh? Yeah, me too! But first – not gonna haze ya, car you brought's lookin' a little worse for wear. Every scratch is a loss, ya feel me?
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Fuck! What shit-for-brains gonk called this a proper ignition! Fuckin' useless scrap!
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Ahaha, relax, just teasing, man. Anyway, c'mon… mean, if I wanted my dick wet I wouldn't stand out in the rain.
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: [Get in] Someone "deliver" this car to you too?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: This one stolen too?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Two – I'm selling 'em. Three – Dogtown's full of chances, an' chances are what I like. Four – you called it a "scheme"? Man, I prefer to call it, uh, "creative license."
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: V! Y'scan this motherfucker?! Gonked again! Preem lookin', but useless. Least with you, it's the other way around.
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Prefer to call things like I see 'em.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Right. What's this "creative" endeavor need from me?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Like to call things by their names, Cap'n. Your squirmy song 'n' dance won't work on me.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Listen, I got, like, a gift. A sixth sense. Ah, I can tell when a ride's bored, needs a change of hands. Sometimes I hear 'em callin' over in Dogtown, sometimes in Night City.
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Gonna need ya ready to grab some easy eds!
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Alright, alright, chill. We don't gotta like each other. Just gotta rake in the eddies!
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Right. And this sixth sense tells you to tell me to bring 'em to this chop shop?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Ooh, "chop shop," please! But... yeah. You rein in the wheels, you rake in the eds. 'Course, it's all part of a larger plan...
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Nope.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Could start shootin'.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Nah, don't think so.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Hmm. Could shoot 'em up. Just one measly cop car.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Relax, we're in my 'hood. Let's see what they want...
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: NCPD, assholes! You got a license an' a reg for them ugly mugs?
speaker: Daniels

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Picked the wrong side street, choom.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Badges got a talent for lookin' the other way. Suggest you try usin' it.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: The mouth on this one! Trainin' 'em better 'n' better.
speaker: Daniels

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Daniels, the fuck, man? You take a fuckin' squad car to pick up a klepped ride? In uniform?!
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Not the only one on his home turf, Muamar. 'Ey, nab a Villefort Alvarado for the top brass too, I'll get the gear for our little plan.
speaker: Daniels

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: I don't fuckin' believe this...
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Hold the phone. El Cap, handin' out bribes? I'm shocked, shocked. There an honest cop left in this city?
text_male: Hold the phone. El Cap, handin' out bribes? Heh, I'm shocked, shocked. There an honest cop left in this city?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: There is. But they lay low. Don't got that fire in their eyes, y'know?
speaker: Daniels

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Preem, thanks for the cred. Car's detes 'n' docs're on their way.
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Sure. What's in it for me?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Dunno if stealin' cars is my thing.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: OK, you just met one of our clients. So... in on the gig?
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: What's this "plan" of yours?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Eh, guessin' "thief" is another bad word around here?
text_male: Guessin' "thief" is another bad word around here?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: You're a real preem listener, V, huh? I prefer to call 'em, eh, "special deliveries"... An-and you, you're my, y'know, delivery merc.
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: [Get out]
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Right… uh, lemme think on it.  Not sure this's really my game.
text_male: Right. Lemme think on it.  Not sure this's really my game.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Sure, sure. Let's see what tomorrow brings. El Capitan'll be en contacto!
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Always drivin' somewhere, might as well pick up some scratch on the way. Ya gonna make it worth my while?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: C'mon, man, with El Capitan, your future's lookin' bright! I'll fix you your gigs, your fancy payouts. Nothing but upsides.
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Countin' on it.
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Well well! Picked up a tail, huh?
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: What's this "plan" you and Daniels mentioned?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Hmm, you drive for me and you'll find out... in due time. So – ya takin' the gig or not?
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: [Get in] You greet everyone with a barb?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: You always toss barbs at peeps tryin' to do you a favor?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Give it to me straight, Cap. The wheels, what's your scheme?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: "Stolen"? Oh V, you're breaking my heart.
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: I like to check my peeps. Check their egos, that is.
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Why'd I get tailed?
speaker: V

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Ya see? It's just biz. C'mon, rain stopped.
speaker: Muamar

title: sa_ep1_introduction_scene_muamar
text: Wait, what?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_holocall_debrief
text: V. A little birdie chirped that you retrieved Zetatech's paraphernalia. Any issues?
speaker: fixer

title: sts_ep1_04_holocall_debrief
text: Nope. All in the drop point. Birdie missed that bit?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_holocall_debrief
text: Hmm… I simply wished to hear it from the horse's mouth. Your payment should arrive soon.
speaker: fixer

title: sts_ep1_04_holocall_debrief
text: Birdie got it. Schematics're in the drop point. Hasan'll deliver the prototype to Zetatech personally.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_holocall_debrief
text: Well, color me shocked – no "Hasan" contacted me. But no matter. At least you still have the schematics.
speaker: fixer

title: sts_ep1_04_holocall_debrief
text: Birdie didn't say? Prototype wasn't around. Got the schematics, though. That an issue?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_holocall_debrief
text: It's certainly... a snag. Zetatech will not be thrilled, but I suppose that's my cross to bear. Transferring your compensation now.
speaker: fixer

title: sts_ep1_04_holocall_debrief
text: Hasan? Pray, elaborate.
speaker: fixer

title: sts_ep1_04_holocall_debrief
text: Corporat, slotted the tech in his eye. S'posed to take the thing to Zetatech after I busted him outta the scav haunt. He call you yet?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_holocall_debrief
text: Hmph. Zetatech will not be thrilled, but I suppose that's my cross to bear. Consider the contract closed.
speaker: fixer

title: sts_ep1_04_holocall_debrief
text: Commendable work, V. My people will take it from here, as per our agreement. Expect your compensation shortly.
speaker: fixer

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: V... Have you made progress? Has Jago... reconsidered?
speaker: mr_hands

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Splendid. Have you anything else to add?
speaker: mr_hands

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Bennett and Arasaka are in bed together.
speaker: V

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Nope, nothin'.
speaker: V

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Actually, yeah. Jago claims Bennett 'n' Arasaka are fuckin'.
speaker: V

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: A fixer, however, separates fact from the spewings of a panicked soul. My concern now, not yours. Still, I thank you for telling me.
speaker: mr_hands

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: 'S all I got.
speaker: V

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Ceremony and wake – both at the Black Sapphire. Aguilar should enter without a hitch.
speaker: mr_hands

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Met with Bennett, too.
speaker: V

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Yep. Met with Bennett, too. Man's a sock puppet, 'Saka's hand up his ass.
speaker: V

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Ah. It's not something I asked you to do... but I do appreciate it. Bennett is still superior to Jago as a candidate.
speaker: mr_hands

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Has indeed. Also, Voodoo Boys're outta the equation.
speaker: V

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Silence is rarely a good sign.
speaker: mr_hands

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: A man with his balls in a vice makes many interesting sounds.
speaker: mr_hands

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: What now?
speaker: V

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Time to pay tribute to the fallen. Aguilar will attend Hansen's funeral service and ensure a smooth transfer of power.
speaker: mr_hands

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Uh-huh… Sounds like you expect trouble.
speaker: V

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Such events can trigger geysers of raw emotion. No two people grieve alike, and rarely rationally.
speaker: mr_hands

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Right, then.
speaker: mr_hands

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Got it.
speaker: V

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Le roi est mort. Vive le roi. Good luck, V.
speaker: mr_hands

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Don't worry, I pulled 'im off, ironed him out. For good, I hope.
speaker: V

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Bennett's outta the picture too. Made 'im rethink his deal with 'Saka. He'll back Jago now.
speaker: V

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: He'll what?! I believe I made myself unequivocally clear. Bennett is to become BARGHEST's leader and Dogtown's ruler! Arasaka involvement is not your concern.
speaker: mr_hands

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Whatever soul-searching you might've done, forget it and undo this mess. Elsewise, our contract is void.
speaker: mr_hands

title: mq304_04_report_holocall
text: Bennett's out too.
speaker: V

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: The word is Dogtown has a new alpha…
speaker: mrhands

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: Bennett took over.
speaker: V

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: Jago took over.
speaker: V

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: Your Bennett's an apex predator. Gonna make a fine new Hansen.
speaker: V

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: With a sensible partner at his side, he stands to achieve more than Hansen ever could.
speaker: mrhands

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: And that a certain merc went against the better judgment of her fixer... I know you met with Bennett.
text_male: And that a certain merc went against the better judgment of his fixer... I know you met with Bennett.
speaker: mrhands

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: Jago always belonged under Bennett. Just not necessarily six feet under him… Still, I'm pleased his contacts weren't buried with him.
speaker: mrhands

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: And Jago will never challenge again. A shame all his contacts went to the grave with him. Regrettable as oversights go, V.
speaker: mrhands

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: Jago's got a good head on his shoulders – just the man you need.
speaker: V

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: So you flatlined Bennett with your own hands. Perhaps you slightly overcommitted to your role?
speaker: mrhands

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: And to Bennett Terra Cognita. Kind of you. The problem is, you sliced up a cake that wasn't yours to share.
speaker: mrhands

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: I am not pleased, V.
speaker: mrhands

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: Did what I could.
speaker: V

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: It is what it is. Gotta live with it.
speaker: V

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: What happened happened, Hands. Time to live with it.
speaker: V

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: Things got a little outta hand. Did what I could, though.
speaker: V

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: Did you, now? When I hire a pro, I expect professionalism. For anything less, I pay less. I trust that's clear.
speaker: mrhands

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: I understand. In any case, consider the contract closed. You'll receive your fee in short order.
speaker: mrhands

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: Do you know what else happened, V? I just reduced your cut. I hope you can you live with that.
speaker: mrhands

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: Marvelous work, V. Worth every enny and more.
speaker: mrhands

title: mq304_07_end_holocall
text: That'll be all for now. I'll be in touch.
speaker: mrhands

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Fine, say fuck-all for all I care.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: You can't control everything.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: We're saving her, no doubt.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Dunno that she can be saved.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Let's finish this.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: I get it, Reed. But you can't have everything under control, not always.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Maybe you're right, maybe you're not. Won't know until we finish this.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: I'm fucking scared, V. Scared my grip on everything is slippin'. There – happy?
speaker: reed

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Maybe so.
speaker: reed

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: But it's good you're here, it matters. It'll all work out, we just have to finish this.
speaker: reed

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Best get to it, then.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: If anyone's lost control in this sitch, it's her, not you. But it's still So Mi. She's there to save, truly. And I believe we will.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: It's an either-or situation, V.
speaker: reed

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Honestly? No idea who we're bustin' outta that convoy, but there's a chance it won't be… that she's not, well…
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: I know. That's what scares me.
speaker: reed

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: We need to finish this…
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: So let's hop to it.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Made up your mind?
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Don't got a lot of time to whittle away.
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Well, we good to move on?
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: We are talkin'.

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Yeah, see that. Spill it, c'mon.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Do you have any questions about MaxTac? Now's the time.
speaker: reed

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Fuck me. Dodgin' always your go-to when the talk gets tough?
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: I'm focused on the op, that's it.
speaker: reed

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Focused, right. That's what it is.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: V…
speaker: reed

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Spare both of us the bullshit.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Either we got it right… could very well be that. Or she's been playin' us for fools from the start.
speaker: reed

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Whaddaya mean?
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Not now, Johnny.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Don't got time for this now, Johnny.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: What're you on about now?
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Chick's a half braindead, half AI-controlled zombie. Yet still the gonk's convinced his old partner's trapped inside. That only he can save her.
speaker: johnny

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Hoppin' off the hope train, are ya?
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Could be he thinks it's his fault.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: What would the big J do? Abandon hope?
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Maybe he's scared this might all be his fault.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Knew guys like him in the army. Gonks who thought they were born to hold people's lives in their hands.
speaker: johnny

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Shit never ended well. Always with a lose-lose.
speaker: johnny

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Know what bein' in the army taught me? Hope dies last 'cause the backstabbin' bitch makes damn sure she gets you killed first so you'll warm the fuckin' grave for her.
speaker: johnny

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Saw many thousand-yard stares – willpower gone, hope hovering for no reason... Wanna bet on miracles? Go ahead. I'll pass.
speaker: johnny

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Your choom, Reed, also requested some badass toys. Offensive turrets, mines, smoke grenades. Latter – not an issue, but the mines and turrets…
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Wanna weigh in, sift through the detes, or leave prep to me? It's your call.
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Let's line 'em up. Extra coverin' fire'll come in handy.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Let's set 'em up around the ambush site.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: All right – two items of biz to nail down. One's your strategy, second's the kit we need to set you up with.
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Turrets, I say – need me some more firepower.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Wanna talk strategy. What're our options?
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Got about as many as there are frilly tea rooms in Dogtown – so not a whole lot. Do best to figure out the position you'll be ambushing 'em from. Then decide if smoke 'nades favor you there.
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Mines're the thing – let's control the battlefield.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Gear – what's on the tasting menu?
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Reed wants both mines and turrets. Well, I want a divorce without sayin' goodbye to a single enny. Can have a cake, but only to stare at it till it goes bad…
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: [End planning] Fine, good positions, all. I'll pick one, set up.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Run through the options again?
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: In a nutshell – terrace is a safe, secure position, stairs give you preem visibility, skybridge lets you get up close and personal real quick.
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Right, clear. Good positions, all. I'll pick one, perch there, set up.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: We can leave 'em some party favors at the skybridge's ends and at the hotel door. Prevent the motherfuckers from takin' high ground. Makes most sense if you'll be firing from there.
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Then again, if you'd rather go street-level, get in close, we can pepper the mines over the road surface.
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: So whaddaya say? We minin' the road or the way up to the terrace?
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Road needs minin'.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Could line 'em up along one side, pile on the pressure, draw attention – good suppressing fire, too. But they're psychos, not gonks, they'll wisen up and go around 'em eventually.
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Option two – place the turrets around the site. Max bastards'll get nailed in the crossfire. It's sure to slow 'em down.
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Your choice – suppressing fire from one side, or lead-poundin' from different angles to slow 'em down.
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: You got it.
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: This thing's gonna play out how you shape it. Grenades'll breed chaos, confuse them. They'll also obscure your view if you're firin' from a distance.
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: What about Reed an' me? Won't it reduce visibility for us?
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Decision's yours. We doin' 'nades or not?
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Yeah, cookin' with gas now.
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Our friend here knows specifics, he'll fill you in. I got one last thing I need to take care of.
speaker: reed

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: [Take shard] Let's do it.
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: I'm all set. You?
speaker: V

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Right on. When fixin' to go out guns blazin', best be on your own terms.
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Hell, I'd be shittin' bricks too, goin' up against MaxTac…
speaker: johnny

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: It's not gonna be easy. The reason they're called "Psychosquad's" two-fold. They're almost cyberpsychos themselves.
speaker: reed

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: We then neutralize all MaxTac operatives, grab Songbird, run 'er to an exfil point just across the SoCal border.
speaker: reed

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Sitch is simple.
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: Short notice, folks. Can hook you up with one or the other, not both. Turrets for firepower, mines for crippling mobility. Your call, boss.
speaker: friend1

title: q305_04_pre_ambush_meeting
text: We set 'nades off on the road, for a time the assholes'll be aimin' and shootin' blind, hopefully each other.

text: It is. It may not be a Corpo Plaza penthouse, but I can’t complain. At least I didn’t sign my life away to a bank.

speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: What're you doing now?
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Thanks, Hasan.
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: So, how’s things? Rough time startin’ from zero?
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: So, what're you up to these days?

text: Honestly? The same things I did at Zetatech.

text: Hasan?
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Hasan?

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Huh, what? I don't know any Hasan!

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Fucking Zetatech... Fucking scavs... Fucking prototype...
speaker: hasan_squat

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Optics! Optics, anyone? They don't need to be Kiroshi...
speaker: hasan_squat

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: I-I'll fucking get 'em. They don't know who they messed with...
speaker: hasan_squat

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: You need help?
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: What happened?
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Lookin' like shit. What happened?
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Dug out my fucking eye, that's what happened! Now I can't even afford a basic implant..
speaker: hasan_squat

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: I went to the ripper, then woke in the middle of nowhere, barely alive, missing an eye! I've lost everything, everything!
speaker: hasan_squat

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Listen... You need some help?
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Yeah, yeah, you could help. Start by finding that butcher who maimed me!
speaker: hasan_squat

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Wonderin' that myself, Hasan. Corps got wide radar 'n' long memories – stick your neck out like this, they could bite.
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Yes, I could have rotted in a scav cage, you could have left me at the fixer's mercy. Could, would, should...
speaker: hasan

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Down payment came from me, though. Seems my cred bought you a second chance.
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Thanks.
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Nah, c'mon. You're just gettin' set up, not gonna clean you out.
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default

speaker: V

text: No, thank you.

speaker: hasan

title: sts_04_hasan_default

text: Now we are even, it seems.
speaker: hasan

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Heh, you wish.
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Well... Dogtown isn’t quite the promised land, is it? I've had to learn its ways. But if I survived in the corp, I can manage here.
speaker: hasan

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Ah, so hazin' peeps and kleppin' their cred?
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Haha. Very funny. Repairing and modifying weapons and implants. Whatever comes my way. Sure, it's older gear, cheaper parts...
speaker: hasan

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: But at least there are no more suits breathing down my neck.
speaker: hasan

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Oh, it's you. What do you want?
speaker: hasan_squat

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Just passin' by.
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Look, I'm just passin' through.
speaker: V

speaker: hasan_squat

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: So you hazed me, is what you’re sayin’.
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: They do not. But they do appreciate... talent. Provided you've got the right skills, you can earn your second chance.
speaker: hasan

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Don't take kindly to ex-suits here, do they?
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: I went to the stadium, showed what I could do... and landed a few investors. This is the first real copy I made – for you.
speaker: hasan

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Told me you had a buyer for the tech all lined up.
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Yeah, I did. And he had a useful idiot – me!
speaker: hasan_squat

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Then... Then we can go after Zetatech. The scavs too! You and me, just like before, yeah...
speaker: hasan_squat

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Uh... Think you better drop it, Hasan. Didn't save your life to see you waste it like this.
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Riiight, you're one of them! Merc bitch on a fixer's leash. Get the fuck away from me, I want nothing from you!
speaker: hasan_squat

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Why didn't you go back to Zetatech?
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: What the...? Thought you were goin' back to Zetatech.
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Drop the haze. Never planned to give up that implant, did you?
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: You hazed me.
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Ya hazed me. Dunno what happened, but this? Brought it on yourself.
speaker: V

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: I-I did, I wanted to, but... I couldn't. I was attacked, they, uh... they took the prototype!
speaker: hasan_squat

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: Do you know how much it was worth? I wanted a fresh start, I needed eddies! Is that so wrong?
speaker: hasan_squat

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: They did take it. I woke in the middle of nowhere, barely alive, missing an eye! I've lost everything, everything!
speaker: hasan_squat

title: sts_04_hasan_default

speaker: hasan

title: sts_04_hasan_default
text: I, uh... yes. That's why I'd like to repay you... Here, for you.

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: The NUSA's Space Force One has been shot down over Dogtown, and with President Rosalind Myers on board!
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: There it is! Dogtown stadium, symbol and heart of the troubled district, now site of a brutal home-grown cyberpsycho attack! We're talking blood, guts, mayhem and more – I'm sure you get the picture.
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: Well, they've done it again! Our sources on the other side say there's been more firefighting and mayhem at Dogtown's stadium!
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: All right, Night City! Let's talk about recent events at the spaceport. And I mean what really happened, corpo rat bullshit notwithstanding.
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: Well, well, we've got another Dogtown scandal on our hands! Turns out the district was home to an organized crime syndicate dealing in what? How about "the underage sports stars of tomorrow?"
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: This just in: You got implants? Well, you're fucked! You heard that right, Night City! F-u-c-k-fucked!
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: We've received disturbing reports about a group of netrunning blackmailers who could hack your chrome! I mean you! Apparently, the group takes over your implants, and if they don't get their ransom... It's sizzle time!
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: Hellooo, Night City! Hey, how 'bout a little story time fun? Now, once upon a time, before the dark, dark days of the DataKrash, Militech built itself a secret underground city within a city – our city!
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: That mysterious complex of underground bunkers, dusty storage rooms and murky laboratories was where they forged a cybernetic weapon that could shift the course of history...
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: Hah, you really believe that fairy tale? A secret military project right under our feet and under Arasaka's nose? Puh-lease!
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: Just another urban legend, I say. But what if there's a grain of truth to every legend? Well, as always, stay tuned – your man Stan's here with his finger on the city's pulse!
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: You heard that right! According to eyewitnesses at the scene, a surface-to-air missile struck the president's craft while in Night City airspace.
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: But who's behind the attack on the NUS president? And why here, why now? All we have is Washington's assurances Myers survived the crash and is safe.
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: But I gotta ask – where's the rest of the story? Why are Militech, Arasaka and Night Corp holding their tongues? Suspicious much? Yeah, my thoughts exactly!
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: Dogtown – the district's all over the news these days, isn't it? Now, some people might call Dogtown a grotesque, ad absurdum bastardization of the American Dream – a place where what's possible depends only on how dirty you're willin' to play.
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: Others see it as a simple pain in the, uh, collective conscience. Once meant to be a bigger, better, flashier Las Vegas, the district is now home only to this old chestnut:
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: "What happens in Dogtown, stays in Dogtown." And I say, let's keep it that way. For our own safety – and peace of mind.
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: Apparently, the cyberpsycho was a member of Kurt Hansen's security forces. That's right, a soldier for the self-appointed leader of Dogtown. Color me not surprised!
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: MaxTac managed to apprehend the cyberpsycho, but if I were you, I'd start giving Dogtown an extra-wide berth.
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: Now, that would be biz as usual in the district, if it weren't for one itty bitty detail – it seems none other than Kurt Hansen was struck down in the chaos.
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: So, who will be Dogtown's next warlord-prince? And what does that mean for upstanding Night Citizens such as ourselves? Guess we're about to find out!
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: A big, fat nothing, that's what! And since Night Corp didn't stand to gain, that means they didn't do it. Easy math for you there, Night City. So, who was it? Now that's where the real story begins!
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: That's right! Seems they were tradin' kids, most of them poor and underprivileged. The group ran a secret Dogtown clinic where they stuffed the little prodigies with the latest supplements and cyberware meant to boost their athletic performance.
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: It remains unclear who first blew the whistle on this shocking story. But don't worry! Our reporters are on the case, so stay tuned!
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: So, have we fallen prey to 'runner terrorists? Or is our own technology getting the better of us? This might be just the beginning – be careful out there, chooms.
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: Orbital Air blames Night Corp for the attack. Night Corp obviously denies it. And you know what? For some reason, I can't help but believe the NC 'rats! What on earth would they get from striking the spaceport?
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: Hmm, let's think – who wants Orbital Air and Night Corp distracted and squabbling? Who'd really like to strengthen their claims in Night City, low-Earth orbit and on the Moon, hm?
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: ep1_radio_05_news
text: I'll give you a hint! This program is sponsored by two little letters: M and A. Which one do you put your eddies on? Let me know, dear listeners – I'd love to hear what you think!
speaker: stanley_media_radio

title: sa_ep1_courier_loop_call_hacking
text: She'll track down your next ride herself. And when you're close to the target, she pops the locks and grabs the steering for you.

title: sa_ep1_courier_loop_call_hacking
text: You take down any huscle around, then bring our prey back to me. Simple? Let's roll!

title: sa_ep1_courier_loop_call_hacking
text: Hey, V. Got a real sweet ride 'round these parts. How 'bout you bring her over? Already know how it's done.

title: sa_ep1_courier_loop_call_hacking

speaker: fixer_voice

title: sa_ep1_courier_loop_call_hacking

text: Sounds like you're out to get your hands dirty in local politics. Pun intended.

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: I trust it's all you need to waltz in and perform your planned pirouettes. Yet, a word of caution... Even fully prepared, you’ll be marching into a pit full of vipers. Watch your step.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Yes, well, Dogtown is a political arena like any other. It has its relations, arrangements, power struggles…
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: A careless businessman might easily drown in the mud. Me – I prefer to stay dry.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Activity is abundant in Dogtown. And behind closed doors – plots and schemes.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Should change ever occur... as it inevitably must…
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Someone really ought to pave the way for a smooth transition…
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: [Get up] Lookin' forward to those new gigs.
speaker: V

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: [Get up] Preem to meet you in person.
speaker: V

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Be lookin' forward to those new gigs, then.
speaker: V

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Nice meetin' you, finally pinnin' a face on the name.
speaker: V

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: You will hear from me soon, this I guarantee you.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: You should count yourself lucky. Few have done so and lived to tell the tale.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: You're going where local and international politics mix – strong currents, both.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Make sure to plant my feet firmly, then. Later, Hands.
speaker: V

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: So, how did this combat zone become "Dogtown" – do you know?
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Dunno. Unification War?
speaker: V

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Don't really care.
speaker: V

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Heard this 'n' that… Somethin' to do with the war?
speaker: V

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Twenty-sixty-nine. Colonel Hansen led an operation colorfully called "Midnight Storm." The objective – to occupy this combat zone and establish an NUSA staging ground in Night City.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Soon after, the sides agreed to a ceasefire. Hansen's force was left to fend for itself. Headquarters, the public, everyone – feigned ignorance, pretending Hansen and company were never here.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: But our good colonel decided to put down roots. He declared this combat zone an NUSA territory. In our terms, he carved out an enclave for himself and went from soldier to arms dealer overnight.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Marooned, he was. Two weeks for a bullet to reach his brain, everyone thought. But his brain remained intact, and he became a force to be reckoned with.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Dogtown, Pacifica, then I'd line up the rest, snort and it'd be done.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Working with bona fide professionals – positively a treat.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Didn’t expect a face-to-face with the elusive Mr. Hands.
speaker: V

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: C'mon, Hands – flattery, really? Seems a little beneath you.
speaker: V

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Maybe the one thing I didn't expect – to see the man behind the holo-curtain. The elusive Mr. Hands in the flesh.
speaker: V

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: An overused tactic, agreed – unnecessary. No, V, this is strictly business.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: For those who do their work well, praise is a mere restating of the facts.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: A man whose existence is a threat to many is a dangerous man, indeed.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Flattery? Really?
speaker: V

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: [Sit and drink]
speaker: V

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Not only did you rescue those clowns in blue, you also managed to eliminate Dodger.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Not only did you rescue those clowns in blue, you also managed to reach an accord with Dodger.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Despite some setbacks, you retrieved the Zetatech blueprints.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: You retrieved the Zetatech blueprints… and the coveted prototype.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: [Take shard] Was countin' on somethin' juicier.
speaker: V

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Honestly? Was countin' on more than hotel blueprints.
speaker: V

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: I have no doubt an industrious individual like yourself will make the best of them. The same goes for some new assignments I will line up for you soon.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: [Take shard] Was countin' on somethin' juicier.
speaker: V

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: You have proven to be a person I can trust. Hence my decision to drop the veil and meet in person. A rare occurrence, I assure you.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Calm, collected and professional. Bravo.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Your head in the game throughout. Well done.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Not all prove willing and able to follow through no matter the cost. I respect that.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: Making impossible decisions under immense pressure – an invaluable skill that few possess.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: I know it may not seem all that clear from where you stand, but…
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: The gigs you have completed will allow me to audaciously shift some of the pawns and figures on the... chessboard that is Dogtown. Checkmate is but a few moves away.
speaker: Mr_Hands

title: q303_04_mr_hands
text: [Knock]

text: Lookin' forward to those new gigs.
speaker: V

text: Preem to meet you in person.
speaker: V

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: Breaking news from Pacifica: Colonel Kurt Hansen, authoritarian ruler of so-called Dogtown since 2070, has died.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: Despite a swift reaction by corporate security forces, the thieves could not be apprehended. Local police are officially investigating the incident.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: According to corporate intelligence sources, Springer was behind last year's attack on the corporation's Paris laboratory.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: A Biotechnica spokesperson assured the public this is only the beginning of their war on anticorporate terrorism.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: This is N54 News, bringing you the latest from the city and around the world. I'm Gillean Jordan.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: Nele Springer, member of the terrorist organization Crimson Harvest known for its bloody attacks on Biotechnica in recent years, was shot dead while undergoing arrest in Dogtown.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: Four Biotechnica operatives were killed while attempting to apprehend a dangerous Crimson Harvest ringleader in Dogtown.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: Nele Springer is wanted in connection with last year's bombing of a corporate research facility in Paris.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: Biotechnica's CEO has appealed to the public for help. The corporation is offering a cash reward for any information on the fugitive terrorist's whereabouts.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: Night City DA Georgina Zembinsky has failed to convict Hector Sacristán, a member of the Valentinos gang, in the murder of local drug kingpin Marcos Ferreira.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: According to our sources, a key witness for the prosecution abruptly withdrew testimony that would have incriminated Sacristán.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: The counsel for the defense firmly denies his client had anything to do with the witness' unexpected decision.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: New reports indicate NUS President Rosalind Myers was aboard Space Force One when it was shot down. The perpetrators of the attack remain unknown.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: The craft was downed over a separatist area in Pacifica occupied by former Militech Colonel Kurt Hansen.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: Our unofficial contacts in Washington have suggested that President Myers was killed in the crash. The administration's press secretary has thus far declined to comment.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: While the circumstances surrounding his death remain unknown, many point to his ties to organized crime.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: Following Hansen's untimely departure, new questions arise: What will happen to Dogtown now? And should Night City prepare for bloody rioting at its gates?
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: A truck holding unknown cargo has been stolen off an Arasaka container ship docked in Night City.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: More details to come following Arasaka's official announcement on the matter.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: I'm being framed – isn't it obvious? The NUSA's been out for my blood for years.
speaker: Kurt_Hansen

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: What transpired in Dogtown is no trivial matter. I urge you all to consider the true motives behind this… spectacle.
speaker: Kurt_Hansen

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: Now, I'm not without flaws. But another thing I'm not is suicidal. An attempt on the life of the head of the NUSA?
speaker: Kurt_Hansen

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: Will they stop there? No. You, good people of Night City, are next in the fucking line.
speaker: Kurt_Hansen

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: The NUSA will take any excuse it can get to send forces into Dogtown.
speaker: Kurt_Hansen

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: Mark my words… another war's on its way.
speaker: Kurt_Hansen

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: "Another war." Those are serious words.

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: Some Night City residents are understandably concerned about the situation. A group of protestors has already gathered at Dogtown's border.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: Among them are members of the 6th Street gang, who are demanding entry to the district.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: The gang, most of whom are armed, claims it's their patriotic duty to check whether the information received on Rosalind Myers is correct.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: The NCPD has yet to respond, but tensions on both sides remain high. The situation could escalate at any moment.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: ep1_radio_06_n54
text: We'll have more details shortly.
speaker: gillean_jordan

text: A handwritten invitation – unachievable. But I can work something out. I'll need a favor in return, though…
speaker: hands

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: What about bribin' someone?
speaker: V

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: All right, Hands. Got yourself a deal.
speaker: V

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: Can’t just bribe someone?
speaker: V

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: Hmm... I’ll need to twist an arm or a leg. Thanks to you, I've a veritable buffet of limbs to choose from.
speaker: hands

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: You helped to solidify my position in Dogtown. I'm happy to return the favor.
speaker: hands

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: Think you could make this a quickie? Tight window I'm workin' with…
speaker: V

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: If you want a smooth deal, the cogs must be greased. Bring me grease, V.
speaker: hands

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: Money... so pedestrian, when you think about it. Reputation, information, favors... these are worth their weight in gold. Heavier even than their owners' hearts.
speaker: hands

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: I’m oh so glad. Auf Wiedersehen.
speaker: hands

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: Yeah, I get it.
speaker: V

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: Yeah, see what you're drivin' at. Want me to help you "earn" a little rep.
speaker: V

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: Precisely…
speaker: hands

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: Complete a few gigs for me. Give my reputation in Dogtown a shot in the buttcheek. The Black Sapphire plans will be yours.
speaker: hands

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: Reputation is a currency. Its value derives from collective faith. It fluctuates. Do you understand me?
speaker: hands

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: Alas, none remain for purchase at the Black Sapphire. Hansen had all the weak of heart purged using a lighter element – lead.
speaker: hands

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: So, you can arrange it...?
speaker: V

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: So, doable, ya think?
speaker: V

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: We'll conclude this in person. I'll need some hours. Meet me at the Heavy Hearts.
speaker: hands

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: Thanks, Hands.
speaker: V

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: Hey, Hands. Our deal – 'member?
speaker: V

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: Yes, the Black Sapphire. I have an entry strategy for you – foolproof. Meet me at the Heavy Hearts.
speaker: hands

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: OK, be there soon.
speaker: V

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: Hey, hold, hang a sec, Hands. 'Member our deal?
speaker: V

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: Hey, hold, hang a sec, Hands. Need your help now.
speaker: V

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: Hm... do tell, V.
speaker: hands

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: Lusting to dance with the devil? V... the place is inaccessible and treacherous – in equal parts. You cannot simply walk in uninvited, as opposed to, say... Konpeki Plaza.
speaker: hands

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: Surely there’s some way in.
speaker: V

title: q303_04b_call_hands
text: Very well, I’ll be frank.
speaker: hands

speaker: V

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: They'll be here soon.
speaker: judy

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: Psh. Told me to keep her on ice until tomorrow. Can you believe the balls?
speaker: judy

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: Gonna put somethin' on her. Rather she look like a person than a body.
speaker: judy

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: Death's a daily thing for 'em.
speaker: V

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: Went easy on them, anyway.
speaker: V

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: Y'know... to you she's your best friend, so it's a terrible tragedy.

speaker: V

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: All things considered, you let 'em off pretty light.
speaker: V

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: Could you wait outside?
speaker: judy

text: Welcome to Night City.
speaker: V

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: Welcome to Night City.
speaker: V

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: I was-- I was only gone an hour…
speaker: judy

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: Huh. Fuck.
text_male: Fwoo... fuck.
speaker: V

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: If I'd just known I'd've…
speaker: judy

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: Can't blame yourself.
speaker: V

text: Don't blame yourself. Won't solve anything.
text_male: Don't blame yourself, won't solve anything.
speaker: V

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: Stop, couldn't watch her twenty-four seven…
speaker: V

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: I should've sensed something, that it was off, augh!
speaker: judy

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: She'd made up her mind. Would've found a way. Always.
speaker: V

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: Not sure we should move her before the badges get here.
speaker: V

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: She's just another dead whore to them – nobody'll care.
speaker: judy

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: No. No imminent danger. A suicide.
speaker: judy

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: Tomo-- No! Today! Ugh, what part of "dead" don't you understand?!
speaker: judy

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: No, she was not pronounced dead by Trauma Team. If she'd've had coverage, we wouldn't be talkin'.
speaker: judy

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: An' fuck you! If you don't wanna move your asses, why don't I come down the precinct and trash it into bits?
speaker: judy

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: Now will you come and arrest me, you pussies?
speaker: judy

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: Fine! I don't give a fuck what you write me up for!
speaker: judy

title: sq026_01a_suicide
text: Least we can do is treat her with some dignity.

text: Big surprise. Who'd wanna be a corpo-fattened pig in Sty City?

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Should be safe here… Phew! I owe you one, truly. It was getting quite ugly back there.
speaker: hasan

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Sure thing. Not like I'm leavin' empty-handed, right?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Well, uh, I suppose I can take it from here. I'll tell my superiors you did one hell of a job.
speaker: hasan

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: So you lied to me.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Why'd you betray the corp?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Prototype's my responsibility now.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Fine. Watch yourself out there.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Fine, don't care. Next time you're in trouble – don't call me.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Ha ha hah...! Worry not my friend, I've learned my lesson. I'll catch my breath now – appreciate your help, smooth sailing, farewell!
speaker: hasan

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Yeah, yeah. Watch yourself out there, Hasan.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: No, no, wait! I, uh… I can't go back to Zetatech.
speaker: hasan

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Know what? Gettin' on my nerves, choom. Ya get one answer – what the fuck's your deal?
text_male: Y'know what? Gettin' on my nerves now, choom. Ya get one answer – what the fuck's your deal?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: My deal, uh… Agh, I don't intend to return to Zetatech. I planned to grab the prototype and vanish into Dogtown.
speaker: hasan

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: How d'you think this is gonna go?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: OK. You an' me – never met. Our story? Scavs got the schematics, prototype went AWOL. We clear?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: You- really?! Y-yes, understood! I… Thank you!
speaker: hasan

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Why you so hell-bent on kleppin' this tech?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Do you have even the faintest idea how much it's worth?
speaker: hasan

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Fuckin' hazed me Hasan. Put my shit on the line for you, and you wanna leave me out to dry?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Now I delta. You? Find a big-ass rock, crawl under it. I mean it, Hasan. Zetatech gets half a whiff – ya dead.
text_male: Now I delta. You? Find a big-ass rock, crawl under it. I mean it, Hasan. Zetatech gets half a whiff – you're dead.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Wait... how in the hell d'you think that's gonna go? I tell my fixer sorry, shit outta luck, prototype bounced?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Sly bastard bamboozled the corp and you in the process. Two-nothin' for Hasan. But I got a feelin' his luck ain't gonna last.
speaker: johnny

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Uh… more'n your life, right?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Bah. I have no family, no friends. I gave my life to the corporation… The sacrifices I made… And for what?
speaker: hasan

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: What life? The bastards stole it!... The money from the prototype would have afforded me a fresh start…
speaker: hasan

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: I had a buyer, I was waiting on the signal to run... Then the scavs attacked and everything went to shit! Going back, it… it would be a death sentence.
speaker: hasan

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Just say it got lost, moved, I don't know. I cut the signal. Your fixer can have the schematics – they're just as valuable!
speaker: hasan

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Calling the fixer. No fast moves.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: We never met, understood?
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Doin' it my way – callin' my fixer. You? Sit tight and shut up.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: I was in a goddam scav cage! You would've left if I'd told you the truth!
speaker: hasan

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: [Shoot Hasan] Sorry it had to end this way.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: So be it, Hasan… Sorry.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Sly bastard survived an ambush, gave scavs the slip and bamboozled a corp. But at some point, everyone's luck runs out...
speaker: johnny

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Brought it on himself. Let's just grab what we came for an' get outta here.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Right… OK…
speaker: hasan

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Sly bastard survived an ambush, gave scavs the slip and bamboozled a corp. But at some point, everyone's luck runs out...
speaker: johnny

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Don't send him back to Zetatech. Like you to find him a mean chrome-doc, extract the tech an' let him walk.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: True. Consider this a gesture of good will. A solid foundation for our mutual cooperation.
speaker: fixer

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Know all too well what those Zeta-pricks got in store for him. So I thought… y'know what? Fuck 'em.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Grab the implant, but let Hasan go.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Hands? Sitch got tangled. Rescued a Zetatech hostage, sole survivor of a scav ambush.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: I see. This impedes your assignment how, exactly?
speaker: fixer

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Well, my choom here 'planted the prototype in his eye socket. Gonna need a ride.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Inconvenient, but not disastrous. Coordinates, please. His escort back to Zetatech will arrive shortly.
speaker: fixer

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: You V? Hands sent me. Here for the schematics.
speaker: hands_man

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Yeah. Here ya go.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Preem, I'll take it from here.
speaker: hands_man

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: I have to say I'm intrigued, V. Is this man worth the effort?
speaker: fixer

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Done and done.
speaker: fixer

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: I appreciate you having my back there. Truly.
speaker: hasan

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Oh, no, no, no. You'll sit tight while I call my fixer, grab some transport. Sure he'll wanna handle the prototype – personally.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: I fucked up, OK?! If I'd known… please, if you send me back, I'm dead!
speaker: hasan

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Maybe, maybe not. But you definitely made a big mistake tryin' to con me.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: You connivin' fuck. Shoulda schemed a little harder 'fore ya squirmed into a 'Saka-Zeta-Scavenger-shitwich.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Then… I give up. Kill me. I'm not being dramatic. I'd rather die by your hand than their tortures.
speaker: hasan

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Newsflash, choom – dead already. They'll find ya an' snuff ya before you walk with that tech.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Sendin' 'em now.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: OK, sending the coordinates.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Hmm… I assume you have a kind benefactor in mind to sponsor your friend's operation?
speaker: fixer

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: C'mon Hands. Y'gotta have some favor to call in, won't cost ya a damn enny.
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: [Wait for Hands' merc]
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: [Stand]
speaker: V

title: sts_ep1_04_hasan_final
text: Wait, wait, you don't... We can make a--

speaker: Reed

speaker: V

speaker: Songbird_vision

speaker: V

text: Think I got it. Our targets – where'll we find 'em?
speaker: V

text: Champagne glass over there – prepped some intel for you. Get it to Reed. You'll need it later.
speaker: Songbird_vision

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Ah, So Mi. Care to introduce your friends?
speaker: Kurt

title: q303_06_paradise
text: It’s not often I'm simply not familiar with guests attending my own party.
speaker: Kurt

title: q303_06_paradise
text: And I never forget a face. Kurt Hansen.
speaker: Kurt

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Hmm. Plus two, I'd say. In any case, enjoy your evening.
speaker: Kurt

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Well... I need to grab you, darling. I've a couple NC politicos here who're dying to meet you.
speaker: Kurt

title: q303_06_paradise
text: I'm all yours, Kurt.
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: [Don't shake hand] V. So Mi’s friend.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: See you soon, V.
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: That's... not happening.
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Song… Fuck…
speaker: Reed

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Name's V. So Mi's plus one.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: They're downstairs. Redheaded twins walled to the teeth with ICE. Kiroshi scans'll show you bunk.
speaker: Songbird_vision

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Up on the mezzanine – isn't that your damsel in distress?
speaker: Johnny

title: q303_06_paradise
text: [Lean]
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: [Stop leaning]
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: [Shake hand] V.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Name's V. Just V.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Interesting. Not the sociable types, are you?
speaker: Kurt

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Haven’t seen So Mi in years. Tryin' to catch up.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Oh, that’s what this is. To me, reunions consist of... picking up the broken, scattered shards of your heart. Or teeth. Always hurts.
speaker: Kurt

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Kurt, meet some friends of mine. Of yesteryear.
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Keepin' somethin' from me, I can tell.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Right. Main thing is to get you outta here.
speaker: Reed

title: q303_06_paradise
text: [Confront] Songbird?
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Party, fancy dress, champagne... Don’t exactly look like a prisoner.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Songbird?
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Gilded cage, V, textbook example. I can’t stick my nose outta this place.
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: See, the Blackwall... it's hard to explain. Each connection, penetration comes at a price…
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: You didn’t. Blackwall did.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: V... it's good you're here.
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Listen, time's precious.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Listen, guys… we do not have the time for this now.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: All the chrome on you... How you appear via the Relic is…
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: I'll explain everything – just need you to listen.
speaker: Songbird_vision

title: q303_06_paradise
text: [Stop leaning] Feels like you tricked me, Song.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Lied to me, Song. Said you had the cure. No mention of a fuckload of flaming hoops I gotta jump through to get it.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: [Take shard]
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: I need a minute to process. And I need a drink. Heading downstairs.
speaker: Reed

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Sure.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Call if you need anything.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Sure thing.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Call me if anything develops.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Not what you expected, huh? Is it the haircut?
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: The, uh, 'runner… your friend... who helped us reconnect last time... Killed him, fried him, didn't I?
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: You didn’t kill Slider. Blackwall did.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Well, could say we brought death to his door.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Could say we both did...
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Lucky as hell it didn't flatline you, too.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Guess the two of us just lucked out.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: I ran out of time. To explain... ev-everything…
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Myers, all of them... I know what they made you do. They pushed and pushed and I... I wasn’t there to stop it.
speaker: Reed

title: q303_06_paradise
text: It is. We got in, we can get out. Just trust me.
speaker: Reed

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Not the point. I'm… dyin', Sol. Like V. Hansen has the "cure" we need. We run now, we both die.
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Whoa. Sharin' a boat to oblivion with me? Coulda said somethin'...
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Had no time. Still don't. But, hear me out… I need help, your help.
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Didn’t mention you were dyin'.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Hansen pulled some tech out of a bunker under Dogtown. Tech that could cure both V and me…
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: And if we're to keep hungry rats from devouring Dogtown, we really do need to feed them the occasional scraps.
speaker: Kurt

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Relic’s killing V... Blackwall's my poison. I can't bow out now.
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: It was no trick. Just... didn’t tell you the whole story.
speaker: Songbird_vision

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Your plan – lemme hear it.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Don't like this, not one bit.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: The cure – how do we get it?
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Not likin' this, not a bit.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: What’s the deal, Song? Doubt I've ever seen a prisoner parade around in a cocktail dress at a swanky party…
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: It’s a charade, V. Doin' what I need to survive, to get what I want. I'm lettin' Hansen show me off like his personal trophy.
speaker: Songbird_vision

title: q303_06_paradise
text: I don't like my situation either.
speaker: Songbird_vision

title: q303_06_paradise
text: In short, it’s storage, a carrier for an AI trapped within certain boundary conditions.
speaker: Songbird_vision

title: q303_06_paradise
text: We need the neural matrix – secret tech that incorporates AIs from beyond the Blackwall.
speaker: Songbird_vision

title: q303_06_paradise
text: The matrix is nested in a mainframe Hansen pulled out of the bunker. The mainframe's secured, but Hansen lacks the key – that's the problem.
speaker: Songbird_vision

title: q303_06_paradise
text: They're bringin' access, I'm bringin' know-how about how to pull the matrix and data off the mainframe. We're to work side-by-side. Givin' us a chance.
speaker: Songbird_vision

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Matrix – we recover it how?
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: No, wait, slow down.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Neural matrix? What is it, exactly?
text_male: Neural matrix – what is it, exactly?
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: When the AI's triggered, it'll execute what's stipulated within those conditions... But I really can’t go into detail now. We don’t have the time.
speaker: Songbird_vision

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Got a plan? Spill it.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: This job... this whole... story about Hansen... Not addin' up somethin' fierce, Song.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: I don’t have time to explain the ins and outs now. V, please, we need the matrix. Focus on the 'runners, find them.
speaker: Songbird_vision

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Hansen needs me and a duo of 'runners who worked on this tech in the past. They actually grabbed access codes they're willing to unload for a price. Classic black market shit.
speaker: Songbird_vision

title: q303_06_paradise
text: A vestige of the past. From a time when I still wasn't…
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: On you?
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: You're dyin'. Yet you need to stay.
speaker: Reed

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Nothing’s ever simple, is it?
speaker: Reed

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Not to mention bein' hella friendly with their captor.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: 'Runners – how we gonna impersonate 'em?
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: So, 'runners – we're to impersonate 'em? How?
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Personality theft tech. Firm kinda specializes in it. Alex and Reed know it well, they'll explain.
speaker: Songbird_vision

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Dress looks good on you.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Lookin' good in the dress.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: You're truly chromed up, different from the hologram.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Don’t exactly look like a prisoner.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Thank you. That was the surprising bit, I'm sure…
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: It's so good you're here. Don’t know what I’d do without you, V. Really.
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Didn't really give me a choice.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: You can count on my help.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Didn’t exactly give me a choice, now, did you? Told me to show up here and just ghosted.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Good to finally meet you in the flesh, face to face. Way our last convo ended was... troubling.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Yep, zeroed him hard.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Yeah, his death’s on you.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Sorry to hear it. Not something I intended.
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Reed's fault, really.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Shouldn’t blame yourself. Reed practically forced the guy to make the connection.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: 'Sides, better him than us, right?
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Got a plan, hear it in your voice.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Yeah. One I can't hope to enact without your help.
speaker: Songbird

title: q303_06_paradise
text: V, I-- I can't explain everything now, it's... too much. But I really do need your help.
speaker: Songbird_vision

title: q303_06_paradise
text: All I want is to get that cure for us. It's what I've been chasin' all along.
speaker: Songbird_vision

title: q303_06_paradise
text: You'll then impersonate them for a meet with Hansen. Same meet where we'll swipe the matrix out from under his nose.
speaker: Songbird_vision

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Wait, what's the rush?
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: I might be talking to you, but in the flesh I'm with Hansen. I'll need to focus, play nice in a minute or he'll suspect something's up.
speaker: Songbird_vision

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Really need to go now, V. I’m countin' on you.
speaker: Songbird_vision

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Preem, noted. Anything else?
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Songbird...? Right, OK…
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: You're blowin' me off…
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Songbird...? Aaand she’s gone.
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: Neural matrix – what is it, exactly?
speaker: V

title: q303_06_paradise
text: It's varied shit for all three of us – there, I said it.
speaker: Songbird_vision

text: It's all right, Song.
speaker: Reed

text: We'll talk later. First order of business, we pull you outta here.

text: We need to klep it. Only way I see of doin' that is to stay close, play the prisoner.
speaker: Songbird

text: We'll wait for an opportunity and pounce. I'll be on the inside, ask for your help when the time's right. I can flee once I have that tech.

speaker: Songbird_vision

text: Listen up. Other day… heard some chrome jock preachin' to high heaven ‘bout Kurt Hansen. Praisin' ‘im for the protection he extends over all those seeking refuge in Dogtown.

text: But check this — our pasts don't define us. Who we are right now, what we strive to become – that's what matters.

text: History’s history, folks – you can't change yours, it’s locked in, hard coded.  But you sure as hell can forge your future...

title: radio_growl
text: Got a biggie to ask you today. Fate – do we control it, or do we wear its leash around our necks? Been thinkin' about this lately, a lot...

title: radio_growl
text: Growin' up, I actually liked the idea of a path, ordained, predetermined  – my future set in stone. Something comforting about that…

title: radio_growl
text: These days? The very notion of having no control over my destiny just rubs me wrong.
speaker: ash

title: radio_growl
text: And on GROWL FM, we're all about accountability. But what do you think? Fate – does it rate with you? Or is it a load of bunk?

text: Talkin' "change" today, folks. The positive kind. Doesn't happen often, but when it does, it usually comes after shit’s hit the fan.

text: You know how they say you shouldn't eat shitty food 'fore goin’ to bed? Things like scop cheese. Pop-Turds, or Tofu’d Tuna…
