title: n54_news_1
text: We begin now with your latest local news.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_1
text: The 54th Anniversary of the AHQ Disaster is fast approaching.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_1
text: In 2023, Night City was shaken to its core by the detonation of a tactical nuclear bomb in Arasaka's NC headquarters.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_1
text: Twelve thousand were killed instantly by the blast and thousands more later succumbed to acute radiation sickness.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_1
text: This tragic incident – which some ultimately attribute to Arasaka's wanton imperialist tendencies – has forever left a mark on our city's history.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_1
text: And now, an important message for Watson residents. The homelessness problem plaguing the district's sewer system will be addressed as fumigation of the tunnels begins tomorrow.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_1
text: Due to the use of potent neurotoxins, Watson residents are urged to stay clear of storm drains and sewer entrances to minimize risk of injury and death.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_1
text: Next – is it the end of eastbound traffic jams on the I-9? Long-awaited repairs to Ringroad East may begin as early as next month.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_1
text: Estimates put investment into this major artery at close to 20 million eurodollars, with priority being placed on efficiency and anti-nomad barriers.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_1
text: And that is it for your lastest local news. After the break, we have a look at our world report.

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: Good evening, Night City! My first guest tonight is the President of the Church of Eliyahu the Last Emancipator – and bane of Arasaka's PR department – one Reverend Colver.
speaker: ziggy_q

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: Praise be to thee, our Father in Heaven.
speaker: reverend_colver

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: Aaaand our second guest is Karina Lee, host of the "Chip In" program which promotes the use of cybernetic implants. How's life treating ya, beautiful?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: Can't complain, Ziggy. Thanks for having me.
speaker: karina_lee

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: Now, I'd like us to talk about the most exclusive and highly sought-after implant on the market today – Arasaka Corp's "Relic."
speaker: ziggy_q

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: But maybe we oughta make sure our fair audience is up to speed. Karina, what is Relic, exactly? In a word, if you could.
speaker: ziggy_q

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: In one word? I'd say... immortality.
speaker: karina_lee

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: Immortality? Really?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: That's right. Relic allows you to transfer the consciousness from a dying person, finding a new home for their soul on a transferable chip.
speaker: karina_lee

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: This person... They'll never leave your side, a companion forever with you in your own consciousness. Just imagine if--
speaker: karina_lee

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: Child, child... Think for a moment about what you're saying.
speaker: reverend_colver

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: This "Relic" is an abomination that feeds on human misery. It is an unnatural likeness, a golden calf born by false prophets.
speaker: reverend_colver

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: Arasaka speaks of preserving the soul, but they can promise nothing more than a heartless, mindless algorithm speaking with the voice of the departed.
speaker: reverend_colver

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: What's more, this technology is just another tool of coercion and corruption. Only the wealthy and powerful elite will have access. And they will pay any price in exchange for a chance at this so-called "immortality."
speaker: reverend_colver

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: Well, th-that is true that Arasaka Corp. has specifically limited access to the Relic in order to--
speaker: karina_lee

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: Your promise is a lie! An evil lie motivated by greed and lust for power that--
speaker: reverend_colver

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: Ha! Now that is rich!
speaker: ziggy_q

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: E-excuse me?
speaker: reverend_colver

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: False promises, greed, a lust for power... Why, sounds an awful lot like a church to me.
speaker: ziggy_q

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: Hahaha…!
speaker: karina_lee

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: Wha-- How dare you!
speaker: reverend_colver

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: Do you not promise a life after death? Do you not charge funeral fees to a family in mourning? Maybe the reverend is just afraid of some healthy competition, huh?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: "C-competition"?! You believe everything in this world can be counted, measured, rationalized...
speaker: reverend_colver

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: And wouldn't we be right? We can construct artificial brains, create new consciousness...
speaker: karina_lee

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: But I ask you "Why?" What does that give us? Are we, as people on this Earth, any happier for it?
speaker: reverend_colver

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: You claim that this Relic gives eternal life, but all I see is an eternity of suffering. Rather than say goodbye, we haunt ourselves with their voices, their prescence. But deep down in our hearts we know that--
speaker: reverend_colver

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: What do you folks think? Who holds the truth? Is it Ms. Lee, or maybe Reverend Colver? That is up to you!
speaker: ziggy_q

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: Send "Colver" or "Lee" to 7892 to cast your vote and enter your name for a chance to win tickets to this year's playoffs!
speaker: ziggy_q

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: ZI-GGY! ZI-GGY! ZI-GGY!
speaker: audience

title: q001_01_arasaka_chip_debate
text: Until next time, Night City! Toodles!
speaker: ziggy_q

title: guns_n_horses_01
text: Gunpowder cartridges these days, am I right? Loud, clunky, and a recoil that'll snap your wrist... You know what I'm gettin' at, right? Maybe, just maybe, it's time to try somethin' new.
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_01
text: Today I wanna tell y'all about Darra Polytechnic's flagship product, the electromagnetic DR-12 Quasar pistol.
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_01
text: Now, I don't usually talk shop on Darra, 'cause, well, they don't have much of a selection. After all, they're an R&D company that makes its bread and butter from patent-licensing. I know, right? Booooriiiing!
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_01
text: But when they DO manufacture a gun, it's almost always to showcase some fancy tech gimmick, which makes 'em preem, granted, but also unreliable and rough 'round the edges.
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_01
text: The exception is Darra's handgun line. The first to hit the stores was called the Nova, 'cept with standard g-powder cartridges there was nothin' nova 'bout it. But the Quasar? Hahaha, now that's a whole 'nother ball game.
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_01
text: The first thing you'll notice about the Quasar is the weird shape of the receiver – as if it was an assembly line error.
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_01
text: But surprisingly, it's a really snug fit. Just, uh... don't expect to find a matching holster anytime soon. Hahaha!
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_01
text: On top of that, it's got this old-timey drum magazine that's a clear throwback to the Depression-era outlaws and bankrobbers of last century.
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_01
text: Here's the twist, though – the drum mag isn't loaded with bullets, but with birdshot. Yeah, you heard me!
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_01
text: Now, I know what you're thinkin' – birdshot? The thing you used to shoot clay pigeons at the shooting range with your pops? Have the great minds at Darra finally gone cuckoo?
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_01
text: Well, birdshot's still the same ol' birdshot, yeah, but it's the projectile speed that's turning heads.
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_01
text: See, hidden inside the Quasar's barrel are four electroconductive rails.
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_01
text: Now, put two opposing electromagnetic fields inside the cylinder, load your birdshot, run a current through the rails...
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_01
text: And BAM! Hahaha! You've just blasted straight through a solid lead surface half an inch thick. Now, how do I know that? 'Cause I tried it myself! Hahaha! Pulling a trigger never felt so good in my life.

title: guns_n_horses_01

title: sq006_02_jefferson_talk_show
text: That was taken out of context. I was responding to a question about my love for the city and how I differ from your average CEO whose only goal is a fatter paycheck. Nasty tricks are a substitute for Holt's lack of achievements, I suppose...
speaker: jefferson_peralez

title: sq006_02_jefferson_talk_show
text: But he claims both crime and unemployment have dropped under his watch.

title: sq006_02_jefferson_talk_show

text: Yo, Miss V. A pleasure.

text: Mind if I ask you somethin' right off the bangle?

title: q001_03a_jackie_dex_intro
text: Got a classic tale for ya. Psychogang, doin' its thing two weeks back, jumped a Militech convoy, got away with the gear. Corp don't even know Maelstrom's involved.

text: Who's the woman?

text: Now see, convoy was carryin' the Flathead – a little combat bot, a prototype. And I need me that bit o' high-grade military tech.

title: q001_03a_jackie_dex_intro
text: Corpo agent, internal affairs. Been skittin' 'round town askin' after the convoy as if her life depended on findin' it. The one lead she got's zip-tied in her trunk.

title: safe_n_sound_05
text: Welcome to "Safe and Sound." My name is Sergeant Dobs, and today I'll show you how to feel safe in your own home.
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_05
text: Our loyal friend Mr. Puggins has just moved into a new apartment. What should he keep in mind?
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_05
text: Starting with the basics, he should make sure that he has the latest NCPD-certified armored doors and blinds. Don't let your prized possessions fall into the paws of petty thieves!
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_05
text: But in the event any criminals do get inside your home, it's always smart to be prepared. That's why Mr. Puggins keeps a weapon in every room, always within arm's reach.
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_05
text: And for you folks who consider no price too high for your safety, consider installing your own home turret system to take care of even the nastiest intruders!
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_05
text: If you prefer the personal touch, hire a private security guard from a reputable corporation. It appears Mr. Puggins learned the hard way that any old gun-for-hire could shoot you in the back at the drop of a hat.
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_05
text: Also, it goes without saying, a home surveillance system is essential hardware to keep an eye out for suspicious activity.
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_05
text: And, of course, Mr. Puggins cannot forget the security of his local micronet. You wouldn't want to give a nefarious netrunner access to your washing machine, would you?
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_05
text: Last but not least – invest in a Kevlar® vest. With an added layer of protection available at all times, Mr. Puggins no longer fears the occasional stray... Bullet, that is.

speaker: std_rcr_glamdoc2_01

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01
text: How'd you make it out?
speaker: V

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01
text: Got lucky, tucked a tire iron up my sleeve. Spite found a bat. Then we just never stopped swingin'. Ate so many bullets - got no fuckin’ clue how we survived. But we weren’t goin' back, not after they abandoned us.

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

speaker: V

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01
text: Where's Dove?
speaker: V

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

speaker: V

speaker: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01
text: Maybe you did leave the Wraiths, but they never left you.
speaker: V

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01
text: Maybe. But take it from an expert - it’s better to go out in a blaze of glory. Survival only guarantees losing everyone you ever cared for.

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01
text: Welcome back. Freedom is up for sale.
speaker: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

speaker: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

speaker: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

title: std_rcr_glamdoc_01

title: safe_n_sound_04
text: Welcome to "Safe and Sound." My name is Sergeant Dobs. Have plans to leave town? Then don't miss this episode!
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_04
text: Poor Mr. Puggins has to make a trip outside the city. What should he know beforehand?
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_04
text: First and foremost, never leave city limits without at least a week's supply of food, water and CHOOH2 canisters. Better to be safe than sorry!
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_04
text: Second, whenever you can, share the road with someone.
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_04
text: And make sure they're well armed. Because sometimes bullets can be more valuable than water.
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_04
text: Third, remember to check the day's weather forecast for any sandstorm warnings.
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_04
text: And last but not least, always be sure to have a valid border pass when you reach city limits. As you can see, the border defense watchtowers made swiss cheese of our dear, innocent friend instead of the nomad outlaws trying to invade our city.
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_04
text: Speaking of nomads, Mr. Puggins will have to keep a sharp eye out once he enters the Badlands. Out there, he won't have the brave men and women of the NCPD at his back.
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_04
text: At the first sign of any nomad activity, Mr. Puggins should head straight back to the safety of the city, or risk becoming vulture kibble in a roadside ditch.
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_04
text: Remember – leaving the confines of Night City is not a matter to be taken lightly. If given the chance, always travel by air.
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_04
text: That's all for this episode of "Safe and Sound." Stay alive out there!
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: n54_news_10
text: Welcome to N54 News. I'm Gillean Jordan, and here's what's happening in the world today.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_10
text: The last active photovoltaic solar farms have been decommissioned in Nevada and Utah.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_10
text: Solar power generation, once seen as the future of clean energy in America, has suffered significant setbacks in today's more extreme climate.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_10
text: The layer of dust suspended in our atmosphere—a result of the Himalayan Wars—has limited the amount of solar radiation reaching the Earth's surface. More importantly, the increasing regularity of hurricanes and sandstorms caused frequent and costly damage to most solar farms.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_10
text: Unsuprisingly, wind power has fared just as poorly. The number of active turbines has plummeted by 63 percent over the last 15 years alone.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_10
text: It appears CHOOH2 will remain the uncontested leader in the energy sector for the foreseeable future.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_10
text: In mainland Europe and the Mediterranean, the humanitarian crisis has grown worse.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_10
text: According to the latest report, as much as twenty percent of the continent is no longer suitable for human habitation.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_10
text: Temperatures in Sicily, Malta, and the Cyclades have reached as high as 140 degrees Fahrenheit. Air pollution in Poland, Bulgaria, and Romania now exceeds the continent's average by more than 2,000 percent.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_10
text: However, heads of state in France, England, and Germany have issued a joint statement in which they preclude the option of government intervention.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_10
text: Their statement reads, quote, "Interference by government authority is interference in the free market. The disruption of natural market mechanisms only serves to hinder the optimal path for solutions to current problems." End quote.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_10

text: Goooood evening, Night City! Our guest with us tonight is Martin Coleman, an ordinary Night Citizen who... well, Martin, how would you describe your situation?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: ziggy_2_lost_implants
text: Well, as you can see, I uh... I lost my arms.
speaker: martin_coleman

title: ziggy_2_lost_implants
text: A real tragedy, Martin. Was it an accident? Were you attacked by Nomads?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: ziggy_2_lost_implants
text: No, nothin' like that... Um, OK, so I, uh, back in fifty-six I was workin' at New American Autoworks.
speaker: martin_coleman

title: ziggy_2_lost_implants
text: The NAA, sure. Go on.
speaker: ziggy_q

title: ziggy_2_lost_implants
text: Well, the company hit a few snags – decided to start cuttin' costs. One day they call us all in to the break room... tell us we're inefficent, slow, weak, what have you.
speaker: martin_coleman

title: ziggy_2_lost_implants
text: So they give us a choice – either we replace our arms with Zetatech cyberware, or we get terminated. No severance package.
speaker: martin_coleman

title: ziggy_2_lost_implants
text: And what did you do?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: ziggy_2_lost_implants
text: What anyone in my place woulda done. I had two girls... a-a wife who couldn't work... I didn't have a choice.
speaker: martin_coleman

title: ziggy_2_lost_implants
text: And it's not like it was free – they forced us to buy 'em on credit. Twenty year installments, fixed to our salaries.
speaker: martin_coleman

title: ziggy_2_lost_implants
text: Everything was fine at first – the arms were all right... but then a year later, NAA went under.
speaker: martin_coleman

title: ziggy_2_lost_implants
text: I was out on the street – applied anywhere I could for a job, walked into every factory. I would've worked for ennies... but there was nothin'. Nada. Zilch.
speaker: martin_coleman

title: ziggy_2_lost_implants
text: I started falling back on my payments. A month goes by, then the second, then the third month. Then Zetatech sends its repo squad.
speaker: martin_coleman

title: ziggy_2_lost_implants
text: I was on my knees, begging for another month, even a week... but they didn't listen. They tased me, ripped out my arms and just left me there. My daughters, they... they...
speaker: martin_coleman

title: ziggy_2_lost_implants
text: I can tell you're still hurting – even got some tears there.
speaker: ziggy_q

title: ziggy_2_lost_implants
text: How about drying them with Militech's brand-new Draupnir 5-X?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: ziggy_2_lost_implants
text: What? No… No, no... This isn't happening!
speaker: martin_coleman

title: ziggy_2_lost_implants
text: Oh, but it is! Ziggy Q's is where it's always happening!
speaker: ziggy_q

title: ziggy_2_lost_implants
text: ZI-GGY! ZI-GGY! ZI-GGY!
speaker: Audience

title: ziggy_2_lost_implants
text: I can't believe it... Ziggy, I... Oh my go-- ...Thank you, hah… thank you...

title: wns_news_05
text: Hello, my name is Arif Iqbal, and this is WNS News.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_05
text: A dead city livens up the news today. Following the catastrophic use of biological weapons in Busan during the Militech-Arasaka Conflict of the early 2020s, essentially all forms of life have been wiped clean from the megacity.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_05
text: Millions of people, animals and plants were eradicated in a matter of minutes. And a similar fate awaits any to this day who strays to close to the southern edge of the Korean Peninsula and the waters surrounding it.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_05
text: Though not all in the city lies still. Automated systems powered by local tidal energy continue to operate unsupervised.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_05
text: NetWatch has warned that without proper maintenance, any Busan-based AI could, in time, pose a considerable threat.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_05
text: Arasaka has washed their hands of the issue, placing full blame for the ecological and subsequent technical crisis with Militech who dropped the bombs. NUSA President Rosalind Myers has declined to comment on the matter.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_05
text: Meanwhile in Europe, the Padanian government is once again in the midst of a campaign to prevent illegal excavations and looting in the city of Venice.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_05
text: Four looters and seven Carabinieri were killed in the most recent altercation.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_05
text: This city submerged under the Adriatic Sea still hides many centuries-old and priceless works of art. High demand from collectors has spurred on the continued looting.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_05
text: Official figures estimate the net worth of Venician sculptures and jewelry sold illegally on the black market would be equivalent to one-third of the Padanian economy's GDP.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_05
text: Most stolen works eventually find their way to collectors in private orbital stations, making reclamation a difficult process.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_05
text: Further west, Switzerland has officially become the first nation committed to a fully automated military by 2080.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_05
text: Already 90 percent of the Swiss armed forces consist of lobos, drones and automated vehicles. The officer corps makes up the remaining 10 percent.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_05
text: As the Swiss government phases out its current officer corps, they will begin implementation of the CVS-Pacem automated command system.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_05
text: As stated in the government's official press release, "Switzerland can at last achieve its goal of true neutrality. CVS-Pacem will secure our borders but will never position Switzerland as the aggressor."
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_05
text: And that's the world's latest. Thanks for joining us. Until next time.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: radio_00_news

title: radio_00_news
text: Has Hanako Arasaka's mysterious parade disappearance just become less of a mystery?
speaker: stanley_media_radio

text: More and more around town are reporting increasingly bizarre behavior exhibited by Delamain autonomous cabs. The common thread? They're short-circ'ing and causin' one helluva to-do.

text: The body count resulting from illegal street racing continues to grow-- Oh, no, excuse me.

text: Yes, yes, yes, that very same Yorinobu who once abandoned his silver spoon to join a Japanese street gang, even dabble in a little domestic terrorism.

text: I dare you to name a better candidate for the world's gunrunner-in-chief!
speaker: stanley_media_radio

text: The Arasaka princess says she was "indisposed for health reasons." She also made a point to support for her brother, Yorinobu, saying, quote, "He is a worthy successor to my father, capable of leading the company to a bright future."
speaker: stanley_media_radio

text: Authorities have urged residents to stay at home or another well-sheltered location. No resources, they say, have been set aside for search-and-rescue efforts.
speaker: stanley_media_radio

text: Two hundred and fifty people are being treated for injuries, seventy remain missing. If you're tuning in today, count your lucky stars, choomba.

text: Oooh, Night City, get ready for the gloves to come off.

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: Gooood evening, Night City! Joining us in the studio tonight is Maria Jimenez, reporter for "The Pacific" and a cyberspace specialist, and of course, the author of her new book – "The Undoing. Fall of the First Net."
speaker: ziggy_q

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: Maria, rumor has it that you were once... a netrunner?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: Hm. Is that right?
speaker: maria_jimenez

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: Well? Is it true?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: Ho, ho, ho, ho! And there it is, folks! Now the question is, Maria – do you still go to cyberspace?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: No. Promised myself I'd never set foot in there again.
speaker: maria_jimenez

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: And why's that?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: Because I don't wanna fry my brain to a crisp.
speaker: maria_jimenez

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: Cyberspace was never safe to begin with, but after Rache Bartmoss unleashed R.A.B.I.D.S... the place turned into a hellscape overnight.
speaker: maria_jimenez

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: Hell as in lakes of fire and demons poking you with pitchforks?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: Uh, no. I'm talking about malware that can flatline you in a matter of nanoseconds, AIs that creep into your brain via your connection, data vortexes that would make a sane person lose their mind.
speaker: maria_jimenez

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: Sounds spooky... but someone must still be in there, right?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: Mhm. Probably over-chipped corpos in cryo-suits using up half the energy grid... Or just crazy people.
speaker: maria_jimenez

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: All right, but let's say I, Ziggy Q, jacked myself into cyberspace...
speaker: ziggy_q

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: Your brain would implode. Literally. The internal pressure in your head'd increase three times over. Without a dedicated--
speaker: maria_jimenez

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: Let's forget about that for a sec... What would I see in those few nanoseconds before I flatline?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: All depends on you.
speaker: maria_jimenez

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: Cyberspace is data flowing straight into your brain. It bypasses all of your normal senses – sight, touch, hearing…
speaker: maria_jimenez

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: You'd have to visualize it somehow. Otherwise... well, you know what happens.
speaker: maria_jimenez

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: You'd see some clouds resonating, pixels falling in a drizzle... hmph. It's hard to describe.
speaker: maria_jimenez

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: Fascinating, and just a tad disturbing. After all, this is cyberspace we're talking about... But us ordinary netizens, we don't have anything to worry about, right?

title: ziggy_3_about_the_net
text: Hahaha! I think you're gonna have to re-read my book, Ziggy.

speaker: V

text: GPS transmitter. The one you forgot to disable on the stolen meds.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: GPS signal.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Sure, sure. And you be careful with that trigger.
speaker: V

text: Hand over the stolen meds and I'm gone.
speaker: V

text: Stolen?! Hahaha! The baloperidol doesn't work! S-so who's stealing from who?! Who?!
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Stolen?! Hahaha! The baloperidol doesn't work! S-so who's stealing from who?! Who?!
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Just hand 'em over and I'm gone.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: H-how'd you find me?
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Aaaargh! I’m not fucking crazy!
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Baloperidol? For cyberpsychosis?
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Easy, easy…
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Sh-shut up! Go away!
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: If it doesn't work, give it to me.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Give it, or I call MaxTac.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: This is our situation.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: If they're no use to you, they don't work, just hand 'em over.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Ripperdocs! They're the real criminals!
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: You're the same as them… rippers, politicians… the same as that fucking Holt!
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: His death would change nothing.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: You're a soldier, not a terrorist.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: I see we're past talking.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Do what you want, but give me the drugs.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Listen, I don't really care.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Wanna murder a mayor? Fine. You think it'll make a difference? Sure, why not.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: I just need those meds.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Ha, ha, ha… I see… It's all so clear…
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Last marble just hit the floor. Can't let this drag on.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: You're part of the system… a--a pawn in it… a slave to it…
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Let's just fight.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: We know where this's headed, rather not waste my time.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: I appreciate your candor.
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: A Militech HKS-47 with polymer reinforcement. You were a soldier.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Militech. 3rd Light Division, 155th Infantry Regiment, 7 years in a fuckin' jungle… When times were simpler.
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Before you got sick?
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: They cast me out like a dead battery.
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: I understand your anger.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Where did you serve?
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: You're angry, and I get it. You feel cheated.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Not just me!
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: I know, but if you zero Holt, you'll make it worse for everyone in your condition. They'll hunt you down.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Where'd you serve?
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Brazil. R-remember all of it… Dirt on my face… F-fatigues always--always wet…
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: It's like a braindance I-I-I can't shut off…
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: The memories flood back?
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Without the adrenaline. Without my brothers… Fuck! So quickly they forgot me…
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: It's campaign season. The first ribbon-cutter to push an anti-psycho policy after Holt's death is winnin' that election.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: No! No, that's not true! The people will understand! The system will start to fall!
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Everyone like you, they'll hunt you all down.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Leave… Go, please…
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: You know I can't without those meds.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Over there… I wanna be alone.
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: But… but soon… I'll find him. End him.
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Other poltician's will make use of his death.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: They'll say you're a psycho.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: The death of one politician won't change anything.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: If you kill Holt, first thing they'll do is brand you a psycho and a terrorist.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Uh-huh.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: It will! These--these silver-tongue devils won't dare turn on their people ever again!
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: A line, I'm drawing a line! They can't treat us this way anymore! They--they--they can't use us anymore!
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: It’s not about ME! This is for everyone! All the sick!
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: No, this'd be a disservice to them. What're people gonna remember?
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Cyberpsycho terrorist on one side, media-backed politicians on the other. Now, who's the crowd favorite?
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: I could think of a few differences.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Shut UP! That bastard, he stole from--from research! He doesn't care about the sick!
speaker: solo

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: "Cyberpsycho assassin kills in cold blood." Who'd wanna help a monster like that?
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: Either you give me what you stole.
speaker: V

title: sts_wat_kab_03_scene
text: How--how can you work for them?

text: You ordinary… sell-out… piece of SHIT!!!

text: You know the expression, "Having the last laugh"?

title: guns_n_horses_02
text: Imagine you're a gun manufacturer, and the NUSA and the Free States are on the brink of an all-out war. What do you do? You do what Midnight Arms did – release a weapon that completely tilts the playing field.
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_02
text: Right now you're lookin' at the semi-automatic Sor-22 rifle.
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_02
text: If you think this beast looks more like a tank gun than a rifle, then you're SOR-ely mistaken, hahaha…
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_02
text: That being said, ballistics testing has so far revealed that the Sor-22's firepower is on par with the Arasaka Aka-ashi.
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_02
text: That means the Sor-22 also has a similar recoil, so if you haven't got a full titanium endoskeletal implant and carbon-fiber muscle weaves, don't even TRY to handle this sonofabitch.
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_02
text: Whoever made this clearly had just two things on their mind – mass production, and war. That means it's gotta be solid and reliable. Comfort and portability are not on the checklist.
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_02
text: I've been in just about every kind of weather condition with the Sor-22 – torrential rain, sandstorms, heatwaves, you name it – and it's never jammed on me, not even once.
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_02
text: Haha, and you can tell the Sor-22's creators were dead serious with this thing, 'cause the instructions are as captivating as a--a washing machine manual. This thing is no nonsense.
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_02
text: The obvious downside to this goliath is, well, its size. Soldiers've already nicknamed it the "Elephant." Couldn't've come up with a better name myself.
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_02
text: So if you wanna know what it's like to hold a real lead-cannon in your hands, there's only one true contender.
speaker: jim_jarry

title: guns_n_horses_02
text: The Sor-22 is available in all firearm stores. And remember, stay loaded!
speaker: jim_jarry

text: Our buddy, Mr. Puggins, is on his way to work when he notices a police cruiser flash its lights behind him.

text: But because he's in a rush to an important meeting, Mr. Puggins decides to ignore the police.
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_03
text: Better think twice, Mr. Puggins. Under the Safe Streets Act, the NCPD has the right to open fire on any vehicle that refuses to pull over. Let's give him another chance.
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_03
text: This time he promptly pulls to the side of the road, and knows to turn off his engine, rest his head against the steering wheel, and place his paws behind his head.

title: safe_n_sound_03
text: As the police officer approaches the vehicle, Mr. Puggins decides he'd like to ask why he's been stopped.

title: safe_n_sound_03
text: Wrong again, Mr. Puggins! It's the police who ask the questions – not you. Remember – never speak or make eye contact with an NCPD officer unless told to do so.
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_03
text: The officer tells Mr. Puggins to step out of the vehicle, but he only moves to stand next to the car. That's not gonna cut it!
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_03
text: In this situation, you must lie down with your face to the ground and paws behind your head. If you don't do this on your own, the officer will be forced to assist you.
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_03
text: Excellent! The officer has finished his search, and everything appears to be in order. Mr. Puggins is free to carry on.
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_03
text: But before hitting the road, don't forget to extend a small token of your appreciation for the police officer's service.
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_03
text: Always follow this advice to enjoy a safe and problem-free relationship with your local law enforcement.
speaker: sergeant_dobs

title: safe_n_sound_03
text: That's all for this episode of "Safe and Sound." Stay alive out there!

title: fb_river
text: Last night I was sittin' at the bar just mindin' my own business, when some guy starts mouthin' off about the kids on the farm.

title: fb_river
text: Sayin' that they must've enjoyed bein' hooked up like cows. That they had it comin'.

title: fb_river
text: Of course, I told him to shut his fucking mouth or else.
speaker: river

title: fb_river
text: Surprise, surprise, he didn't listen. So we took it outside and... well, you know what happens next.

title: fb_river
text: They're holding me at the precinct in Little China – you know where. Holler if you can help your ol' River out one last time. Thanks...

title: fb_river
text: So I've been to every precinct in the city, every hospital, emergency room, every single rippderdoc...

title: fb_river
text: Nobody knows what happened to you. It's like you're a ghost.
speaker: river

title: fb_river
text: If that job went sour then I guess... I guess that's it, then.
speaker: river

title: fb_river
text: But if everything went like it was supposed to, V... if you're alive... just call me, please. You owe me that much.
speaker: river

title: fb_river
text: Anyway, uh... Bye, I guess.
speaker: river

title: fb_river
text: Couple fellas from the fifth precinct busted a shop sellin' illegal iron.
speaker: river

title: fb_river
text: Sawed-offs, stun guns, mustard gas cannisters...
speaker: river

title: fb_river
text: Orders from on up were to blow it all to the ground, but then I thought... maybe there's a better way to use all this stuff. For a good cause.

title: fb_river
text: I still remember what you did for us. For me and Randy.
speaker: river

title: fb_river
text: This city needs more people like you... and I'm gonna make sure they're equipped.
speaker: river

title: fb_river
text: This one's on me, V. See you around.

title: q005_02_saburo_documentary_part_1
text: 1919 was a year of great change in our history. The onset of American prohibition, the end of World War I...
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: q005_02_saburo_documentary_part_1
text: And the birth of Saburo Arasaka.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: q005_02_saburo_documentary_part_1
text: From an early age, Saburo was heavily involved in the business his father had founded.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: q005_02_saburo_documentary_part_1
text: As a young man, he quickly demonstrated the work ethic and natural talent becoming of an exceptional manager. That is, until his promising career was abruptly interrupted by war upon his doorstep.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: q005_02_saburo_documentary_part_1
text: Saburo Arasaka enlisted as a pilot in the Nippon Kaigun, the Japanese Imperial Navy. By the age of 23, he had already achieved the rank of Lieutenant.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: q005_02_saburo_documentary_part_1
text: With 20 confirmed aerial victories, he forever will be honored as one of the Imperial Army's most accomplished fighter pilots.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: q005_02_saburo_documentary_part_1
text: But in 1942, during a routine mission, his plane was severely damaged.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: q005_02_saburo_documentary_part_1
text: Yet, overcoming both grievous injury and a malfunctioning aircraft, Saburo managed to return to base... Join us after the break to hear what happened next.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: Yeah. I got work here, man. So not coming down. You manage on your own.

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: I will contact you with any news.
speaker: Takemura

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: I am linking you in. We both can listen.
speaker: Takemura

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: I know that borged out ogre!
speaker: Johnny

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: Adam fuckin' Smasher!
speaker: Johnny

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: Guy who killed you?
speaker: V

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: Chill. Sure it was him?
speaker: V

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: Guy who killed you, right?
speaker: V

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: Guy?! Motherfucker's barely human!
speaker: Johnny

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: Chill out a sec. Sure it was him?
speaker: V

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: I'd recognize that voice anywhere!
speaker: Johnny

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: But hey – know what? I'm glad he's here.
speaker: Johnny

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: Catwalk don't look too stable…
speaker: Johnny

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: Sure Takemura didn't plan a little "whoopsy-daisy" for ya?
speaker: Johnny

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: Told ya so.
speaker: Johnny

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: Sniper! He can see you! Hide!
speaker: Takemura

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: Stay hidden!
speaker: Takemura

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: Not yet, V!
speaker: Takemura

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: You must be more careful.
speaker: Takemura

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: Wait there until it is calm. I will signal you.
speaker: Takemura

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: Remember, they can still detect you.
speaker: Takemura

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: You're glad?
speaker: V

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: Seein' as I woke up in a world without any Saburo, I'll have to be satisfied with Smasher.
speaker: Johnny

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: You gotta be satisfied? You got fuck-all to lose!
speaker: V

title: q112_07a_parade_gameplay_and_combat_routines
text: All right, fine – we. Your finger on the fuckin' trigger, I guess.
speaker: Johnny

text: Mhm.

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Just like that.
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Hmm…
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Possible enemy activity.
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Area's clear.
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Probably nothing.
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Enjoying your run-in with the corporation? Guess not, huh?
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Come out!
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: We have a problem! High alert!
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: I'm on it.
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Terrorists!
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: They're attacking us!
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Oooff!
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: I'm trying to get through!
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Drive her back!

speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Get your shit together!
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Went clean through.
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Uh.
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Watch it.
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Bye.
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Oh come on, what can they--? What can they do, huh…? That's right.
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: That's a problem how…? Listen, we'll put on our company gear and go for a stroll, how's that?
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Get into position!
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: I'm on it!
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Take cover!
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: You too.
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Not again…
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: All right. Get to work.
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Hoh. Let's see what we got.
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Get movin'.
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Cover me!
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Arghhh... Fuckkk... Fuck... You.
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Oh relax… Mm… Yes.
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Regroup!
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Got a dead soldier! Search the area!
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Jesus Christ...
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Spread out! I didn't put any call out!
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Taking heavy losses!
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: You killed them all!
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25
text: Come at me!
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

text: We've got her pinned down!

text: Reloading!
speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

speaker: sec_mid_f_02_enus_25

title: q005_03_saburo_documentary_part_2
text: The injury sustained by Saburo Arasaka in 1942 ultimately proved serious enough to disqualify him from further combat missions.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: q005_03_saburo_documentary_part_2
text: He could now only watch as the Empire he defended began to suffer more and more losses, until their eventual and unconditional surrender in 1945.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: q005_03_saburo_documentary_part_2
text: According to family accounts, Saburo – gripped by despair and shame – had resolved to commit seppuku, but then changed his mind at the very last moment... Why? No one knows.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: q005_03_saburo_documentary_part_2
text: From the day he nearly took his own life, Saburo Arasaka has refused to speak about his wartime experience with anyone. He devoted his complete attention to one thing alone – his work.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: q005_03_saburo_documentary_part_2
text: Following the death of his father, Sasai Arasaka, in 1960, Saburo assumed control of the family business.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: q005_03_saburo_documentary_part_2
text: Under his direction, their humble company began on its path to becoming a world-leading corporate giant.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: q005_03_saburo_documentary_part_2
text: It was in 1990 when Arasaka Corp. first emerged on the Global 500 list. Then in 1996, after the collapse of the United States, it rose to number two in the rankings.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: q005_03_saburo_documentary_part_2
text: At the most trying time in our history, Saburo Arasaka provided thousands of Americans with reliable work, and helped us regain a sense of our former prosperity.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: q005_03_saburo_documentary_part_2
text: For that, we will always owe him a debt of gratitude. Arigatou-gozaimasu, Saburo-san
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_01
text: Hello, my name is Arif Iqbal, and this is WNS News.

title: wns_news_01
text: In today's international segment, we turn our eyes towards Asia.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_01
text: The summit between China and India has ended with the signing of a new trade agreement.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_01
text: Under the agreement, the tariffs for iridium, dysprosium, and lanthanum – rare metals necessary for the construction of Chiyou-II orbital station – have been lifted.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_01
text: The signatories have also agreed to the free movement of organic persons and biopodders between the two countries.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_01
text: This is the latest step in the two nations' push for greater economic integration and the benefits such cooperation brings. This flies in stark contrast to the NUSA's protectionism and trade war policies under President Myers.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_01
text: In science news, Biotechnica researchers have announced another breakthrough in genetics – the restoration of three previously extinct animal species – the North American beaver, the swift fox, and the eastern cottontail.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_01
text: Though back from the dead, these species will not be reintroduced to their natural habitats for fear of an increased risk for zoonotic disease similar to the Great Bird Flu of 2061 and the Rat Fever of 2072.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_01
text: For the time being, the animals will only be grown on special order.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_01
text: The people of Turkey are bracing themselves for a radioactive sandstorm yet again this year.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_01
text: Meteorologists expect southern winds to carry several dozen tons of irradiated dust from the former states of Syria, Iraq and Iran.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_01
text: The fallout from these territories – devastated during the so-called Suicide War – remain the primary source of radiation that falls onto Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: sq023_01_rachel_talk_show
text: Good evening, Night City! My very special guest tonight is braindance producer Rachel Casich. You may remember her from such BDs as "Maxwell's Rehab" and "Cyb3rpsych0sis."
speaker: ziggy_q

title: sq023_01_rachel_talk_show
text: Rachel's been known to rustle a few hornets' nets, and she's at it again with her latest project – "The Passion of Joshua."
speaker: ziggy_q

title: sq023_01_rachel_talk_show
text: Did your publicist tell me right? You want to recreate Christ's crucifixion?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: sq023_01_rachel_talk_show
text: That's exactly right, Ziggy.
speaker: rachel_casich

title: sq023_01_rachel_talk_show
text: Complete with nails, spears, thorns – all the gory details?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: sq023_01_rachel_talk_show
text: Right again, Ziggy. Just as the Bible describes it.
speaker: rachel_casich

title: sq023_01_rachel_talk_show
text: Were you only taking auditions from actors who have experience in coming back from the dead? Zombies maybe?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: sq023_01_rachel_talk_show
text: Hahahaha! No, unfortunately that wasn't something we hoped to achieve with this project.
speaker: rachel_casich

title: sq023_01_rachel_talk_show
text: In that case, I'm guessing you didn't have many actors eager and lined up for the role.
speaker: ziggy_q

title: sq023_01_rachel_talk_show
text: No, no... Our search began in the prison system, with people on death row. Seeing as how they were destined to die soon anyway, well...
speaker: rachel_casich

title: sq023_01_rachel_talk_show
text: Why not die... for you?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: sq023_01_rachel_talk_show
text: No, not for us. Their death would help others. We hope the experience will awaken something in people, give them insight and direction in their lives.
speaker: rachel_casich

title: sq023_01_rachel_talk_show
text: And you have no issue casting a loathesome criminal as the savior of the universe?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: sq023_01_rachel_talk_show
text: I'll answer you with a piece of wisdom from Saint John Chrysostom – "Be ashamed when you sin, don't be ashamed when you repent."
speaker: rachel_casich

title: sq023_01_rachel_talk_show
text: Our actor, Joshua Stephenson, has committed horrible crimes, it's true... But he deeply regrets them, and he seeks redemption.
speaker: rachel_casich

title: sq023_01_rachel_talk_show
text: If it's not too early, what's next for you after this? Saint Lawrence burned alive on a spit? Saint Cassian stabbed to death by children?
speaker: ziggy_q

title: sq023_01_rachel_talk_show
text: That depends on the success of this project. We're always eager to make sequels.
speaker: rachel_casich

title: sq023_01_rachel_talk_show
text: Hohoho! I just hope we have enough convicts to go around! Thank you, Rachel, and until next time Night City!
speaker: ziggy_q

title: ybimb_1
text: Today we'll be taking a deep dive into Petrochem BetterLife. How's the CHOOH2 super-producer doing these days?
speaker: josh_kavorkin

title: ybimb_1
text: In a word – tanking. 2076 was a painful year for Petrochem thanks to severe droughts. Soybean and corn – the fuel's primary components – suffered record-low yields.

text: And the salt in the wound? The governments of Brazil and Colombia – where Petrochem has its largest plantations – have planned to seize crop harvests in an effort to quell surging famine and unrest.

title: ybimb_1
text: Although Petrochem's expert team of lobbyists have prevented the seizures so far, the company's stock still plummeted as much as 11 percent last year.

title: ybimb_1
text: But before you kick 'em outta the window... Petrochem CEO Lars Muhammed announced last week the planned acquisition of one million acres of arable land in the USSR, specifically in its Kazakh, Turkmen, and Dagestani territories.

title: ybimb_1
text: Such a weighty investment likely ensures the company will never again suffer from supply shortages that could slow the flow of CHOOH2.
speaker: josh_kavorkin

title: ybimb_1
text: Should Muhammed's gamble pay dividends, we can expect a mighty resurgence of investor confidence and skyrocketing stock prices.
speaker: josh_kavorkin

title: ybimb_1
text: In other words – get out there and buy, buy, buy!
speaker: josh_kavorkin

title: q201_03_news_about_confrontation
text: Over the past several weeks, tensions between Arasaka Corp. and Militech escalated to troubling levels.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: q201_03_news_about_confrontation
spoken_original: 「継続は力なり」――アラサカ社の基本理念です
speaker: yorinobu

title: q201_03_news_about_confrontation
text: Saburo Arasaka and NUS President Rosalind Myers have agreed to meet in person to lay the groundwork for a lasting peace.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: q201_03_news_about_confrontation
text: Many pundits and analysts warned of a possible outbreak of armed conflict.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: q201_03_news_about_confrontation
text: The exacerbation of tensions was heightened when Yorinobu Arasaka assumed leadership following his father's death and accused Militech of his murder.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: q201_03_news_about_confrontation
text: However, in an unexpected shift, the return of Saburo Arasaka appears to have defused the situation between the rival megacorporations.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: q201_03_news_about_confrontation
text: My son, Yorinobu, forgot the wisdom in these words. He sought too much change too quickly.
spoken_original: 息子のヨリノブはこの言葉を忘れ、焦って変化を求めすぎました
speaker: yorinobu

title: q201_03_news_about_confrontation
text: I have repeated to allies and enemies alike one simple truth – what is perfect requires no change.
spoken_original: 私が敵味方両者に説き続けてきた教訓――完璧な物を変える必要はない。これが真理なのです
speaker: yorinobu

title: q201_03_news_about_confrontation
text: Thank you.
speaker: yorinobu

title: q201_03_news_about_confrontation
text: A first step of goodwill was taken today as the Arasaka CEO withdrew from Night City fifteen armored vehicles from the company's Aka-ashi series.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: q201_03_news_about_confrontation
text: Stay tuned to N54 News for developments on this story.
speaker: gillean_jordan

text: My name is Arif Iqbal. Thank you for joining us on WNS News.

text: We begin today with a look at the local news.

title: wns_news_04
text: Arasaka Corp. has signed a cooperation agreement with Night City University.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_04
text: Professors and students now have the option to acquire an Arasaka Ōzukumi Sx cognitive implant on loan at a 20 percent discounted rate.

title: wns_news_04
text: Sources tell us installation of the implant will become a requirement for all faculty and enrolled students before long.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

text: In a troubling turn, twelve fatalities have been reported in Vista del Rey. City coroners have confirmed botulism as the cause of death.

title: wns_news_04
text: It appears the common thread between all the victims is the same type of canned meat.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_04
text: The NCPD urges everyone to purchase meat only from approved culinary labs. Meat butchered from natural sources is likely to contain harmful toxins and pathogens.

text: After botulism, the next bug Night City will catch is Lizzy Wizzy fever as she announces her upcoming concert series.

text: The world-renowned singer and artist is due to visit Night City soon.

text: Tickets will only be available for purchase to those with a credit rating above 700. For all of Lizzy Wizzy's other fans, the concert will be available to view through domestic feeder units.

text: And that's your latest, Night City. Until next time.

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: You look just as you did when I found you in the rubbish. Get up.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Takemura? What're you doin' here?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: [Sit] What're you doin' here?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: [Sit] Blunt, as usual.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Takemura. Blunt as usual.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: They say you demanded someone tell you the truth.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: It is an awful place... It is no wonder you are losing your mind.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Come all the way here to take me home?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: They asked me to speak with you.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: What'd you want to talk about?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Your beloved boss is back.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: What exactly are you up to now?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Who was it asked you to talk to me?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: What're you gonna do now? Still aim to protect Saburo's ass?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: I have been transferred to Japan. I will fly from here to Takamatsu.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Why?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: New times, new duties. But we say far too much about me.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Fine, so what is it you got to tell me?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: I am sorry to say it is not good.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Who asked you? Who wanted you to talk to me? Hanako?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: And what did they say?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: I will be blunt – the surgery did not help.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: You will be dead before winter.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: But they've got experts, the best specialists...
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Sorry, don't believe you.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Fuck.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: How... How is that possible? Arasaka's got the best and brightest.
text_male: How... How's that possible? Arasaka's got the best and brightest.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Sorry, don't believe you.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: You wished to know the truth. There it is.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: I... I really thought it'd all work out, end better than well.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Fuck.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Still got options?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: A few months, that's all I got, right?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: You promised Arasaka would fix me.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Dead in a few months – that's me, huh?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: You will feel better at first, but then the illness will grow fierce, attack in full force.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Your final weeks you will spend in bed.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Said Arasaka would fix me if I helped you – you promised.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: I believed truly they could.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Said you had powerful friends. Where're those friends now?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: I did not come with empty hands. We must speak about your options.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Hanako Arasaka promised to save my life.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: It is the reason she sent me here – to discuss the alternative.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: What're you talkin' about? Trusted you all once already. You let me down.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: You may join the "Secure Your Soul" program. Hanako Arasaka has agreed to it.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: You will leave your body. Arasaka will store your engram in Mikoshi until a way is found to transfer it to a new body.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Store? Can't I get a new body right off?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: With technology as it is now, this is impossible.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Seemed pretty damn possible for Saburo Arasaka.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: He returned in his son's body. Tissue compatibility made things easier.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Don't wanna land in Mikoshi.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Arasaka just wants another soul in its collection.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Sorry, not buyin' it. Arasaka's out to lock me up.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: You overstate your importance. To the Arasakas, I fear you are nobody – were nobody.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: With this offer, Hanako Arasaka rewards you generously for your service. There is not, as you say, "more to the story."
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: There will be a contract to protect you. Sign it, and you will live.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Saw Saburo Arasaka's back. In Yorinobu's body.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Yes. Justice has been done.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: So – got your revenge? Feel satisfied?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: I believe Hanako Arasaka chose the best solution.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Whole family's fucked up.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Saburo Arasaka should've stayed dead.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Feel bad for Yorinobu Arasaka.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Whole family's all kinds of fucked up. You know that.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Please watch what you say.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Sister kills brother to plant her murdered dad in the brother's corpse? Straight-to-feeder flick right there.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: They are diferrent from you and me. We do not have the right to judge them.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Saburo shoulda stayed dead.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Many wish him dead, but he will survive them all.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Y'know, the Arasakas belong in some sad old tragedy. Some Shakespeare-level shit there.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Yorinobu 'specially.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: You regret his fate?
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Wanted out of his dad's shadow, whatever the cost. Died at the hand of his worst nightmare.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: You must accept the truth, then listen to what I say. There are options.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: They have kept you here in this cell? For days? It is barbaric.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: [Sit on bed]
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: [Take contract]
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: It is written here that you relinquish all rights, but do not worry. The law is simply behind the times – an engram is not legally a person.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: So I get to be corporate property first?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Like many braindance stars and politicians, from what I know. The program is a success, there have been no complaints.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: And if I say no?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: This is not a prison. You will take your things and return to Night City.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Hey. What's your name?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Hajime.
speaker: Security_guard

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Hajime, lemme ask you somethin'. What would you say to a person who walked right into their greatest foe's jail to save their life?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Hm. I would say, "All right. But do not forget the way home."
speaker: Security_guard

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: [Stand] See you around?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: [Sign contract]
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: [Take things and return to Earth]
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Were I you, I would sign. But the choice is yours. Think it through carefully.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: [Take cube]
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Arasaka keeps its word, always.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Don't wanna die.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: A good choice.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: The engram station is ready for you. We should not wait for your condition to worsen.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: [Surrender to Arasaka]
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Made my decision.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Goin' back to Earth, goin' home.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: You will die there.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: [Show middle finger]
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: [Return to Earth]
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Gonna see each other again?
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: I believe we will.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: So… see you.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: You're all right, Takemura, I like you. Thanks for comin' all the way up here to help.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: What is that?
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: [Stand] Goodbye, Takemura.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: ("A thing of beauty will never fade away.")
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: ("I see your eyes, I know you see me, you're like a ghost how you're everywhere.")
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: I have come to speak with you.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Sorry, guess I'll never understand what you see in the guy.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: You did not spend your life at his side and-- well... I did not come here to talk about the Arasakas.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: She has forgotten you already. They called from here, from the clinic.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: They said someone should talk with you. Someone you know.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: No, no – the operation was a success, and that is why. But the changes the chip made were too great – even for the corporate neurosurgeons.
speaker: Takemura

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: This is fuckin' Arasaka! They should figure somethin' out!
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Fuck.
speaker: V

title: q201_08_cabin_day_30_takemura
text: Please, feel no anger. I wish to speak about an alternative.
speaker: Takemura

title: n54_news_7
text: Welcome to today's local news on N54. I'm Gillean Jordan.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_7
text: For the third consecutive year, Militech has been touted as Night City's best corporation to work for.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_7
text: This prestigious award can be attributed to the numerous employee benefits they offer, such as five paid vacation days a year, unlimited access to stimulant pharmaceuticals, and implant-acquisition assistance.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_7
text: Were that not impressive enough, 34 percent of Militech employees have also been promised a retirement package.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_7
text: In other news, the NCPD welcomes a boost to its authority. As of today, the police may detain criminal suspects for up to one year without formal prosecution.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_7
text: The NCPD scored another victory with the adoption of a policy allowing the shooting of a limb to be considered a warning shot – a change that should keep officers safer.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_7
text: The Night City Office of Cybernetic Technology has been formally dissolved as a result of budget cuts.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_7
text: The office formerly responsible for implant certification will shutter its doors next Tuesday.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_7

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Seems you got a real problem with authority.
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Their leader.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Seemed in a hurry to delta the hell outta there.
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Let's just say Saul wouldn't have been happy to see me.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: What happened?
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: The reason we came to California was because he promised change for the Aldecaldos. He claimed we would turn over a new leaf.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: But you saw it. We got a handful of tents on a heap of sand. A hell of a promised land.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: I wanted something different, better. Saul's a damned coward. He'll be the end of the clan. I'm certain.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: You got a real problem with authority.
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Mitch and Scorpion seem fond of you.
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Scorpion and Mitch – they veterans? Those combat implants…
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Mitch and Scorpion seem good souls.
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Were those two in the army?
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: The best friends a girl could ask for. I'd stay in the camp too if I were in their shoes. Fuck Saul and his generators, of course – yet the clan comes first.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Still treated you like you're one of them. They care about you.
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Mhm.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Do you have anyone you would call close?
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Nope.
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Sort of.
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Maybe soon. We'll see.
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Haven't been so lucky.
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Well... kinda, sorta, off an' on.
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Not right now, no. Could just be a matter of time, though...?
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: I see.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: "Kinda, sorta, off an' on."
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Pfff. Ooo-K.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Scorp and Mitch? Yeah. Panzerboys. They were on contract during the last war.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Panzerboys? Flew those huge transporters?
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Scorpion piloted. Mitch ran security.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: They both got some kick-ass combat implants and a stack of really fucked up nightmares.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: First – we don't know how many are coming. My thinking is it'll be a sizeable crew.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: How much do you know about Rocky Ridge?
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: So, Rocky Ridge – empty, dusty hole in the middle of bumfuck nowhere, I heard. Natives either moved to Night City or just got the hell out.
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Then you know almost all there is to know.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: The whole area was waiting on a new interstate extension. It was supposed to breathe new life into the town. It didn't happen, of course.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Second, we have to create an opening to get to my car. If they're bunched together, we won't stand a chance.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: So we give them a little light show at the intersection?
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: How many ghost towns you think are there? Hundreds?
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Country-wide? Thousands.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: I drove down I-Eighty the other day. All you have to do is pull over after sundown. It's quiet then. And you hear it.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: What's that?
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: The wind whistling through boarded-up windows. Tumbleweeds scratching across dry, sandy tracks.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: What?
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Rogue, Saul… He your leader?
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: That's how towns die. Not with a bang, but with whispers and whimpers.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: So, classic route – good ol' diversion?
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Think flippin' on the lights at the intersection'll give us the upper hand? Really?
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: You know it.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Yes. We'll breathe some life into this dusty old town.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Fine idea. Let's get us some power. I'll look around for access points.
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Relax. Got a few ideas. I'll try to play a little game with 'em at the intersection.
speaker: V

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Hell yes, perfect.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: Great. They're likely to show up in numbers, we can't know how many.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: We need to outfox them, then get to my car somehow.
speaker: panam

title: q103_07_ghost_town_drive
text: The Raffens will roll in after dusk, right? We will have a surprise ready for them. We just need to get some power flowing.

text: Welcome to the N54 News world report. I'm Gillean Jordan.
