title: n54_news_9
text: Scientists from BioDyne Systems have announced a breakthrough in the fight against multiple sclerosis.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_9
text: MS is one of the few diseases that cannot be cured by replacing the affected tissue with implant technology.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_9
text: But the experts at BioDyne have created nanites that, when injected into the spinal cord, provide long-term, uninterrupted repair to the neural tissue.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_9
text: The cost of this cutting-edge therapy treatment has been listed at 700,000 eurodollars per month.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_9
text: For the second consecutive week, the landfill inferno in the remnants of Atlantic City continues to rage on.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_9
text: The 10,000-acre dumping ground ranks among the world's largest and contains both toxic and biological waste.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_9
text: Already seven firefighters combating the blaze have died, and another forty have suffered from severe burns and toxin exposure.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_9
text: The Swedish Academy Award for Literature has announced its latest recipient, Virginia Granchester, citing her most recent book, "In the Shade of an Apple Tree," as a treasure of this generation.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_9
text: Granchester, who is an AI created by Raven Microcybernetics, has been lauded for several of her works over the years.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_9
text: Her first novel, "Requiem for a Samurai," which was published in 70 languages simultaneously, sold over 3 million copies.
speaker: gillean_jordan

title: n54_news_9
text: "In the Shade of an Apple Tree" is a drama set in twentieth-century Ireland, and is already considered a masterpiece of post-collapse literature.

title: wns_news_09
text: Hello and welcome to WNS News. I'm Arif Iqbal.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_09
text: Today, we have several important public service announcements. In Arroyo, a terrorist group dubbing itself a "trade union" has been eradicated.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_09
text: These self-proclaimed representatives of Night City's working class attempted to organize a strike which could have led to financial losses in the millions.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_09
text: Remember – if you come across these so-called union representatives, immediately contact the NCPD or the appropriate corporate security forces.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_09
text: More and more patients have been filing into hospitals throughout Night City with injuries caused by malfunctions in illegally purchased cyberware.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_09
text: Unauthenticated implants have caused several fatal short-circuits already.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_09
text: The NCPD urges all cyberware users to buy only from licensed manufacturers. It's worth the investment.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_09
text: Numerous nomad caravans have appeared near city limits in North Oak and Charter Hill.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_09
text: Some reports suggest some of the violent vagrants may have entered Night City despite the NCPD's best efforts.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_09
text: If you spot a nomad, remember that you have the right to self-defense. With such dangerous criminals, warning shots alone are not considered an effective deterrent.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_09
text: Now, today's final story – an NCART station is stunned by a bloody massacre.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_09
text: The unidentified assailant opened fire on passengers waiting for the train on platform 2 at Med Center. Ten people are confirmed dead and 16 injured.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_09
text: We advise Night Citizens to thoroughly consider all transport options to find the safest solution.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_09
text: Thanks for tuning in to WNS News. Stay safe out there, Night City.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_08
text: My name is Arif Iqbal, and this is WNS News.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_08
text: We have a breaking development for today's international news segment... Or should I say interplanetary?
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_08
text: In a daring orbital heist, millions of eurodollars worth of goods were stolen from Galileo.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_08
text: The thieves docked with the station during a solar storm, which temporarily blinded radar systems, then breached the hull of an Orbital Air laboratory.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_08
text: The "space pirates," as some have dubbed them, made away with several experimental prototypes. Their current heading is unknown, but the ESA has offered a generous reward for any assistance in apprehending the suspects.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_08
text: Back on Earth, a story of optimism emerges from Detroit.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_08
text: The motor city formerly infamous for a century of economic decline and squalor has at last reached its new golden age.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_08
text: As good fortune would have it, the city's numerous landfills, abandoned buildings and industrial zones are rich in rare resources now highly valued in today's economy.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_08
text: Thousands of migrants have caught "junk fever" and set their sights on the city in the search of electronics manufactured around the turn of the century.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_08
text: Undeterred by hazardous conditions and gang violence, these pioneers truly demonstrate the beauty of the American entrepreneurial spirit.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_08
text: Today's closing story – Sinhgad Studios has announced a new way we, as a society, can care for our elderly.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_08
text: Rather than place our infirm elders in an expensive care center on the other side of town, we will soon be able to connect them to the SilverDays system.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_08
text: SilverDays is an advanced feeder unit adapted to the needs of our eldest relatives. The all-inclusive system consists of a catheter, aspirator, IV drip, nutrition tube and, most importantly, a next-gen braindance wreath.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_08
text: Your loved ones will be able to forget the worries of today and return to the simpler times of their youth, all reconstructed from your own personal family archives.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_08
text: Don't waste another minute – pre-order SilverDays now to receive a 10 percent discount!
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

title: wns_news_08
text: And I wish you all a bright and shiny day. Thanks for tuning in to WNS News.
speaker: towfiq_iqbal

speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: But at least the kids that contract it, if they survive into adulthood, they make it with no lasting effects.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: At least that's what the docs say anyway, but I'm not so sure.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: See, back in the 2020s, just before the 4th Corporate War broke out, this unidentified AV went down near Heywood.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: Whatever it was carrying, it was bad stuff. In less than a month, 600 adults had died of a previously unknown disease that just melted them, literally.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: The whole thing got contained, cleaned up, covered up. The CDC, back when that was a thing, said that it was some sort of flu. Yeah, like a flu that melts your body.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: But on the street, they knew the truth: it was a bio-weapon. And on the street, they started calling it the Carbon Plague.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: Now, the story goes that the orphan kids mostly wound up going to surviving relatives or the special orphanage the Night Foundation set up after the tragedy.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: And the story should end there, but it doesn't. Some of those kids weren't the same afterwards. They could do things. Things that shouldn't be possible.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: Mind-reading. Hacking without a deck. Telekinesis. Literally comic book stuff.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: Story gets murky at this point, but sometime during the war, those kids all vanished. Officially counted among the missing after the downtown bombing.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: Some say they ran off. Another story I've heard is that some corp got wind of their abilities and kidnapped them, using the chaos of the war as cover.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: Now, personally, I'd like to think they busted out, made their escape and they live free to this day.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: So, maybe some of them are listening now? You wanna tell me your story, give me a call.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: I'll make sure you can't be traced. And I'll make sure the truth gets known.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: Copy your personality engram into a chip and your loved ones don't have to say "goodbye" when you finally die.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: Carry your dear sweet grandma around on a chip, ask her for advice or a pick-me-up whenever you need it.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: Eternal life of a sort. Of course, this is only on offer to the richest and most powerful people. Immortality isn't for squeebs like you and I, the common man.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: But is there more to it than that?
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: We know that Arasaka's been working on mind emulation technology for half a century now.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: Most notably with the infamous Soulkiller. You've probably heard of it.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: It's a Net-Weapon capable of copying your mind to a secure server and leaving your body an empty vessel.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: And what do they do to the copies? Interrogate them, do some experimentation, a little torture... You know, the good stuff.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: So you, a billionaire executive, decide to get yourself copied...
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: ... so your precious offspring never have to be without your sage wisdom.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: Or so you can give your annual speech at the company Christmas party. I mean, what would the world do without you?
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: And Arasaka gladly makes a copy of your brain, puts it on a chip and hands it over. But not before making a copy for themselves.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: And that copy goes straight to digital interrogations...
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: ... where they pull your psyche apart, bit by bit, until they've squeezed every last memory out of you.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: Every compromising situation, every crime, every heartache. Your secret fears and desires.
speaker: maximum_mike

title: radio_01_conspiracy
text: And now you belong to them, literally.

text: Yeah, someone in Arasaka's marketing division should get a raise for this one.

text: And remember, operators are standing by.
speaker: maximum_mike

text: ... a special bulletin. Saburo Arasaka, the antient patriarch of the Arasaka corporation, has died.

text: Eh, just kidding folks, you're too smart for that. You and I both know he's not really dead.

text: Saburo Arasaka's spent nearly a hundred years now on a quest for eternal life.
speaker: maximum_mike

text: He's guarded around the clock by a private army and lived for the better part of this century in a med tank designed to regenerate organic tissue.

text: Guys like that, they don't just die. They certainly don't just get 'murdered by rivals'. What would Saburo even be doing in Night City?

text: No, folks. This is a smokescreen for something. And it wouldn't be the first time.

text: If you're old enough to remember the 4th Corporate War, there was a wide-spread report that Saburo had been killed by the Japanese SDF in a bid to end the war.

text: Of course, it turned out not to be true and the war dragged on for another year. No, you can take this one to the bank.

text: It's only a matter of time before Saburo's gonna show up on TV, tell us all he's back as CEO and ready to take the Arasaka corporation into the next century.

text: That was the Rubicones bringing you their big hit, "Trauma".

text: And if you happen to live in Night City, they're basically the only game in town for your medical care.

text: If you watch their ads or listen to the testimonials, they say they'll come to your aid in a pinch, patch you up, get you on your feet again.
